items.label: canonicalMatrixSequence_posDef_of_identityOrbit
items.statement:
An identity-initialized operator orbit has positive-definite canonical
matrices at every step when its secant curvature is strictly positive.
items.title: canonicalMatrixSequence_posDef_of_identityOrbit

items.label: canonicalMatrixSequence_zero_eq_one
items.statement:
An operator initialized at the identity has identity as its initial canonical
matrix representation.
items.title: canonicalMatrixSequence_zero_eq_one

items.label: canonicalMatrix_posDef_of_operatorStrictPositive
items.statement:
Strict positivity of a self-adjoint operator implies positive
definiteness of its canonical real matrix.
items.title: canonicalMatrix_posDef_of_operatorStrictPositive

items.label: canonicalMatrix_posDef_of_pushforward_one
items.statement:
Helper for an arbitrary invertible coordinate factor sends the identity operator to a
strictly positive canonical matrix.
items.title: canonicalMatrix_posDef_of_pushforward_one

items.label: exists_identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_initialPosDef
items.statement:
Every parameterized strong-Wolfe counterexample with a
positive-definite initial inverse Hessian admits an automatically normalized
identity-initialized strong-Wolfe operator certificate.  The existential
output displays the factor and the positive distortion constants
`a = q` and `b = ‖A‖ + 1` together with every map inequality consumed by
`identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_factorized`.
items.title: exists_identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_initialPosDef

items.label: exists_matrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfe_of_initialPosDef
items.statement:
every paper-range strong-Wolfe counterexample with positive-definite
initial inverse Hessian admits a matrix identity-initialized certificate with
some positive, ordered Hessian bounds and a strictly positive gradient liminf.
The bounds are generated from the positive square-root factor of the initial
matrix.
items.title: exists_matrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfe_of_initialPosDef

items.label: factorAndBounds_of_initialPosDef
items.statement:
Helper for a positive-definite initial inverse Hessian determines
an invertible self-adjoint factor and explicit lower and upper Loewner bounds
for its pullback and pushforward identity operators.
items.title: factorAndBounds_of_initialPosDef

items.label: factorInitialInverseHessian_and_pullback
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure: The matrix orbit of a certified inverse iteration has
an operator orbit whose initial factor can be normalized by a continuous linear
equivalence.
items.title: factorInitialInverseHessian_and_pullback

items.label: gradientNorm_liminf_pos
items.statement:
Helper for a weak-Wolfe counterexample's positive gradient limit is the paper-facing
strictly positive `liminf` statement.
items.title: gradientNorm_liminf_pos

items.label: gradient_ne_zero
items.statement:
Helper for the nonzero secant denominator in a classical inverse iteration rules out a
zero gradient at every iteration index.
items.title: gradient_ne_zero

items.label: hessianBounds_pos_le
items.statement:
Helper for positive Hessian bounds and the nontrivial Euclidean state space give the
paper's ordered parameter statement `0 < m ≤ M`.
items.title: hessianBounds_pos_le

items.label: identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_dimension_ge_two
items.statement:
A dimension-indexed strong certificate in the paper's Wolfe range
can be normalized once its concrete witness and factorization are supplied.
The witness is an explicit argument so that the factor equation refers to the
same trajectory used by the conclusion.
items.title: identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_dimension_ge_two

items.label: identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_factorized
items.statement:
A strong-Wolfe counterexample with an explicitly factorized
initial inverse Hessian can be affinely normalized to identity initialization.
The parameters `a`, `b`, and `q` are explicit lower/upper Loewner bounds for
the Hessian pullback and gradient pushforward, respectively.
items.title: identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_factorized

items.label: identityInitialized_fixedWeakWolfe_of_factorized
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure: Fixed-constant weak-Wolfe specialization of
`identityInitialized_of_factorized`.  The output bounds remain the explicitly
transported `(a / 2, 3 * b / 2)` bounds rather than the original constants.
items.title: identityInitialized_fixedWeakWolfe_of_factorized

items.label: identityInitialized_of_factorized
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure: Pulling back a fixed weak-Wolfe certificate through a
factorized initial inverse Hessian yields an identity-initialized operator
certificate.  The parameters `a` and `b` are the explicit lower and upper
Loewner distortion constants for the Hessian bounds.
items.title: identityInitialized_of_factorized

items.label: initialInverseHessianPosDef
items.statement:
The initial inverse-Hessian approximation of a certified counterexample is
positive definite.
items.title: initialInverseHessianPosDef

items.label: levelSetWeakWolfeAdmissible
items.statement:
Helper for A certified global weak-Wolfe counterexample supplies the
level-set admissibility data used by the paper-facing predicate.
items.title: levelSetWeakWolfeAdmissible

items.label: matrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeWithObjective
items.statement:
Helper for cor:identity-initialization: square-root normalization and
matrix reconstruction retain the exact pullback objective.
items.title: matrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeWithObjective

items.label: matrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfe_of_factorized
items.statement:
Helper for an explicit factorized strong-Wolfe trajectory yields a classical matrix
identity-initialized certificate with the paper-facing positive gradient liminf.
items.title: matrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfe_of_factorized

items.label: orthogonalSum
items.statement:
A weak-Wolfe DFP counterexample remains one after adjoining an identity
quadratic block on an orthogonal finite-dimensional summand, provided the
identity Hessian lies between the original bounds.
items.title: orthogonalSum

items.label: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv
items.statement:
Pulling a weak-Wolfe DFP counterexample back through a linear isometry
equivalence preserves its Hessian bounds, Wolfe conditions, and positive
limiting gradient norm.
items.title: pullback_linearIsometryEquiv

items.label: scalar_le_of_identity_loewner_bounds
items.statement:
Helper for scalar lower and upper Loewner bounds on the identity operator are ordered
on every Euclidean space whose coordinate index has at least two elements.
items.title: scalar_le_of_identity_loewner_bounds

items.label: weakWolfeAdmissible
items.statement:
A certified weak-Wolfe counterexample supplies the admissibility data used by
the global convergence predicate.
items.title: weakWolfeAdmissible

items.label: decreaseRatio_eq_one_sub_normSq_add_correction
items.statement:
If an objective agrees with a translated half squared norm at two points
and its reference gradient splits into the quadratic displacement plus a
correction, then its exact decrease ratio has the corresponding quadratic and
correction terms.
items.title: decreaseRatio_eq_one_sub_normSq_add_correction

items.label: directions_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the search-direction sequence at an iteration index.
items.title: directions_apply

items.label: existsHessianHolderPullback
items.statement:
Helper for cor:identity-initialization: a continuous linear change of
coordinates preserves existence of a positive global one-half Hölder constant.
items.title: existsHessianHolderPullback

items.label: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexample
items.statement:
Parameterized planar strong-Wolfe assembly. The invariant
slow-curve construction supplies a planar certificate for every admissible
pair of symbolic Wolfe coefficients.
items.title: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexample

items.label: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexampleHolder
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the planar strong-Wolfe construction has a globally
one-half Hölder Hessian, with all properties attached to the same objective.
items.title: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexampleHolder

items.label: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexampleHolderSharp
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the planar strong-Wolfe counterexample has exact
Hölder exponent one half, already on its initial objective sublevel.
items.title: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexampleHolderSharp

items.label: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexampleWithProperty
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: any objective and point-sequence property that holds
uniformly for sufficiently small realizations of every invariant slow curve can
be imposed on the same parameterized strong-Wolfe counterexample.
items.title: existsPlanarStrongWolfeCounterexampleWithProperty

items.label: existsStrongWolfeCounterexampleHolder_of_dimension_ge_two
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: in every dimension at least two, one classical strong-Wolfe
counterexample has the exact Hessian bounds and a globally one-half Hölder Hessian.
items.title: existsStrongWolfeCounterexampleHolder_of_dimension_ge_two

items.label: existsStrongWolfeCounterexample_of_dimension_ge_two
items.statement:
A parameterized planar strong-Wolfe counterexample extends to every
finite dimension `n ≥ 2` with the same Hessian bounds and Wolfe coefficients.
items.title: existsStrongWolfeCounterexample_of_dimension_ge_two

items.label: gradientChanges_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the gradient-change sequence at an iteration index.
items.title: gradientChanges_apply

items.label: gradients_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the gradient sequence at an iteration index.
items.title: gradients_apply

items.label: hessianBounds_lower_le_upper
items.statement:
Helper for uniform lower and upper Loewner bounds on a Hessian force the lower scalar
bound to be no larger than the upper scalar bound on a nontrivial space.
items.title: hessianBounds_lower_le_upper

items.label: hessianHolderOn_sublevel_of_comp
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: a Hölder Hessian bound on an
initial sublevel pulls back through an invertible linear coordinate change.
items.title: hessianHolderOn_sublevel_of_comp

items.label: identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_parameterRange
items.statement:
The identity-initialized strong-Wolfe corollary is exposed with
the explicit witness, factorization, and Loewner/gradient bounds required by
the operator-level normalization theorem.
items.title: identityInitializedStrongWolfe_of_parameterRange

items.label: main_not_globalWeakWolfeConvergence_forall_parameterRange
items.statement:
The preceding negative convergence theorem is uniform over all
coefficient pairs satisfying `0 < c₁ < 2 / 3` and `2 / 3 ≤ c₂ < 1`.
items.title: main_not_globalWeakWolfeConvergence_forall_parameterRange

items.label: main_not_levelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence_forall_parameterRange
items.statement:
The level-set global-convergence predicate is false for every
coefficient pair in the paper's stated range.
items.title: main_not_levelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence_forall_parameterRange

items.label: mem_objectiveSublevel_iff
items.statement:
Helper for membership in the initial objective sublevel set is
exactly the corresponding objective-value inequality.
items.title: mem_objectiveSublevel_iff

items.label: not_PaperRangeGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence
items.statement:
A direct negation of the positive convergence predicate
quantified over the paper's coefficient range.
items.title: not_PaperRangeGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence

items.label: not_PaperRangeLevelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence
items.statement: The level-set paper-range convergence predicate is false.
items.title: not_PaperRangeLevelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence

items.label: not_globalWeakWolfeConvergenceAt_of_counterexample
items.statement:
Any weak-Wolfe counterexample disproves the fixed-coefficient global
convergence claim at its own coefficients.
items.title: not_globalWeakWolfeConvergenceAt_of_counterexample

items.label: not_levelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergenceAt_of_counterexample
items.statement:
Any weak-Wolfe counterexample disproves the level-set global
convergence claim at its own coefficients.
items.title: not_levelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergenceAt_of_counterexample

items.label: not_tendsto_zero_of_pos_limit
items.statement: A real sequence with a strictly positive limit cannot converge to zero.
items.title: not_tendsto_zero_of_pos_limit

items.label: not_universalGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence_of_counterexample
items.statement:
A single admissible weak-Wolfe counterexample refutes the universal global
convergence claim over all Wolfe coefficients.
items.title: not_universalGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence_of_counterexample

items.label: not_universalLevelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence_of_counterexample
items.statement:
Helper for A single admissible counterexample refutes the universal
level-set global convergence claim over all Wolfe coefficients.
items.title: not_universalLevelSetGlobalWeakWolfeConvergence_of_counterexample

items.label: positive_liminf_of_eventually_lower_upper
items.statement:
Helper for a sequence with an eventual positive lower bound and an
eventual finite upper bound has strictly positive real `liminf`.
items.title: positive_liminf_of_eventually_lower_upper

items.label: positive_liminf_of_tendsto
items.statement:
Helper for convergence of a real sequence to a positive value identifies its
`liminf` with that value and hence makes the `liminf` positive.
items.title: positive_liminf_of_tendsto

items.label: steps_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the scaled-step sequence at an iteration index.
items.title: steps_apply

items.label: twoStepSequence_even
items.statement: The even terms of a flattened two-step sequence are its boundary data.
items.title: twoStepSequence_even

items.label: twoStepSequence_odd
items.statement: The odd terms of a flattened two-step sequence are its intermediate data.
items.title: twoStepSequence_odd

items.label: map_apply
items.statement: The bundled endomorphism `map` acts by matrix-vector multiplication.
items.title: map_apply

items.label: matrix_mulVec
items.statement: Multiplication by `matrix` in coordinates.
items.title: matrix_mulVec

items.label: weightedSum_apply
items.statement: Evaluation of the explicit weighted coordinate-sum seminorm.
items.title: weightedSum_apply

items.label: weightedSum_comp_le
items.statement: The explicit contraction bound as an inequality of seminorms.
items.title: weightedSum_comp_le

items.label: weightedSum_contracts
items.statement: The stable endomorphism contracts `weightedSum` at the rational rate `1 / 3 < 1`.
items.title: weightedSum_contracts

items.label: weightedSum_isContracting
items.statement: The explicit weighted coordinate-sum seminorm makes `map` contracting below one.
items.title: weightedSum_isContracting

items.label: weightedSum_isEquivalent
items.statement: The weighted coordinate-sum seminorm is equivalent to the standard norm seminorm.
items.title: weightedSum_isEquivalent

items.label: activeIndices_subsingleton_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport
items.statement:
A point belongs to the topological support of at most one member of a
pairwise-disjoint family of topological supports.
items.title: activeIndices_subsingleton_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport

items.label: fderiv_eq_at_center
items.statement:
At an active center outside the cluster set, the ordinary Fréchet derivative of a
pointwise disjoint finsum is the derivative of the unique active summand.
items.title: fderiv_eq_at_center

items.label: fderiv_eq_at_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
The first Frechet derivative of a pointwise disjoint finsum at a designated center
equals that of the centered summand without an active-support assumption.
items.title: fderiv_eq_at_center_of_disjoint

items.label: finsum_eq_eventuallyEq_at_center_of_pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall
items.statement:
Near the center of a positive-radius pairwise-disjoint closed ball, a supported finsum is
eventually equal to its centered summand.
items.title: finsum_eq_eventuallyEq_at_center_of_pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall

items.label: finsum_eq_single_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport
items.statement:
A point in one member of a pairwise-disjoint support family sees only that summand in the
pointwise finsum.
items.title: finsum_eq_single_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport

items.label: gradient_at_center
items.statement:
The gradient of a pointwise disjoint finsum at an active center is the certified gradient
of its active summand.
items.title: gradient_at_center

items.label: gradient_at_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
The gradient of a pointwise disjoint finsum at a designated center is the certified
gradient of the centered summand, without requiring active support at the center.
items.title: gradient_at_center_of_disjoint

items.label: gradient_finsum_of_pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall
items.statement:
The gradient of a pairwise-disjoint positive-radius closed-ball finsum at a center is the
gradient of its centered summand.
items.title: gradient_finsum_of_pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall

items.label: gradient_halfNormSq_sub_add_finsum_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
The gradient of a translated quadratic plus a pointwise disjoint finsum at a center is
the displacement from the quadratic center plus the centered-summand gradient.
items.title: gradient_halfNormSq_sub_add_finsum_center_of_disjoint

items.label: gradient_halfNormSq_sub_add_indicator_compl_finsum_center
items.statement:
The gradient of a translated quadratic plus a zero-extended disjoint finsum at a center
is the displacement from the quadratic center plus the centered-summand gradient.
items.title: gradient_halfNormSq_sub_add_indicator_compl_finsum_center

items.label: halfNormSq_sub_add_finsum_apply_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
If the centered summand vanishes at its center, adding the pointwise disjoint finsum
does not change the translated quadratic value there.
items.title: halfNormSq_sub_add_finsum_apply_center_of_disjoint

items.label: halfNormSq_sub_add_indicator_compl_finsum_apply_center
items.statement:
If the centered summand vanishes at its center, adding the zero-extended disjoint finsum
does not change the translated quadratic value there.
items.title: halfNormSq_sub_add_indicator_compl_finsum_apply_center

items.label: hasGradientAt_at_center
items.statement:
A gradient certificate for an active summand transfers to the pointwise disjoint finsum
at the same center.
items.title: hasGradientAt_at_center

items.label: hasGradientAt_at_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
A gradient certificate for the centered summand transfers to the pointwise disjoint
finsum even when the center is outside every topological support.
items.title: hasGradientAt_at_center_of_disjoint

items.label: hasGradientAt_finsum_of_pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall
items.statement:
A gradient certificate for a centered summand transfers across a pairwise-disjoint
positive-radius closed-ball finsum.
items.title: hasGradientAt_finsum_of_pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall

items.label: hasGradientAt_halfNormSq_sub_add_finsum_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
A centered-summand gradient certificate gives the corresponding gradient certificate
for a translated quadratic plus the pointwise disjoint finsum.
items.title: hasGradientAt_halfNormSq_sub_add_finsum_center_of_disjoint

items.label: hasGradientAt_halfNormSq_sub_add_indicator_compl_finsum_center
items.statement:
A centered-summand gradient certificate gives the corresponding gradient certificate
for a translated quadratic plus the zero-extended disjoint finsum.
items.title: hasGradientAt_halfNormSq_sub_add_indicator_compl_finsum_center

items.label: hasGradientAt_indicator_compl_finsum_at_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
A gradient certificate for a centered summand transfers to the zero extension of the
pointwise disjoint finsum at that center.
items.title: hasGradientAt_indicator_compl_finsum_at_center_of_disjoint

items.label: iteratedFDeriv_finsum_eq_centered
items.statement:
At a designated center outside the cluster set, every available iterated derivative
of a pointwise disjoint finsum equals that of the corresponding summand. No assumption
that the center belongs to the summand's topological support is needed.
items.title: iteratedFDeriv_finsum_eq_centered

items.label: summable_apply_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport
items.statement:
Pointwise evaluation of a family with pairwise-disjoint topological
supports is summable.
items.title: summable_apply_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport

items.label: summable_of_support_subsingleton
items.statement: A family with at most one nonzero term is summable.
items.title: summable_of_support_subsingleton

items.label: support_apply_subsingleton_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport
items.statement:
At each point, the values of a family with pairwise-disjoint topological
supports have subsingleton function support.
items.title: support_apply_subsingleton_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport

items.label: tsum_apply_eq_single_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport
items.statement:
At a point in one topological support, the pointwise infinite sum of a
pairwise-disjoint support family is the corresponding summand.
items.title: tsum_apply_eq_single_of_pairwiseDisjoint_tsupport

items.label: tsum_apply_eq_zero_of_forall_not_mem_tsupport
items.statement:
If a point lies in none of the topological supports, the corresponding
pointwise infinite sum is zero.
items.title: tsum_apply_eq_zero_of_forall_not_mem_tsupport

items.label: tsum_eq_single_of_support_subsingleton
items.statement:
If a family has at most one nonzero term and its value at `k` is nonzero,
then its infinite sum is that value.
items.title: tsum_eq_single_of_support_subsingleton

items.label: tsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
items.statement: If every term of a family is zero, then its infinite sum is zero.
items.title: tsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero

items.label: value_eq_at_center
items.statement:
The value of a pointwise disjoint finsum at an active center is the value of its unique
active summand.
items.title: value_eq_at_center

items.label: value_eq_at_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
The value of a pointwise disjoint finsum at a designated center equals the value of
the centered summand, including when both sides vanish near that center.
items.title: value_eq_at_center_of_disjoint

items.label: value_indicator_compl_finsum_eq_at_center_of_disjoint
items.statement:
At a designated center outside the cluster set, the zero extension of a pointwise
disjoint finsum has the value of the centered summand.
items.title: value_indicator_compl_finsum_eq_at_center_of_disjoint

items.label: analyticOnNhd_coordinate
items.statement: The signed-angle coordinate is real-analytic throughout the identity chart.
items.title: analyticOnNhd_coordinate

items.label: coordinate_mem_interval
items.statement: Every signed-angle coordinate lies in the arctangent branch interval.
items.title: coordinate_mem_interval

items.label: coordinate_one
items.statement: The signed-angle coordinate of the identity matrix is zero.
items.title: coordinate_one

items.label: coordinate_rotationMatrix
items.statement: On the local branch interval, the coordinate recovers the real rotation parameter.
items.title: coordinate_rotationMatrix

items.label: coordinate_rotationMatrix_toReal
items.statement:
On the local branch, the matrix coordinate agrees with the canonical real angle
representative.
items.title: coordinate_rotationMatrix_toReal

items.label: coordinate_unique
items.statement: The local real parameter of a special orthogonal matrix is uniquely its coordinate.
items.title: coordinate_unique

items.label: isOpen_chart
items.statement: The signed-angle chart is open in the ambient matrix space.
items.title: isOpen_chart

items.label: mem_chart
items.statement: Membership in the signed-angle chart is positivity of the upper-left entry.
items.title: mem_chart

items.label: one_mem_chart
items.statement: The identity matrix belongs to the signed-angle chart.
items.title: one_mem_chart

items.label: rotationMatrix_coordinate
items.statement: A special orthogonal matrix in the identity chart is recovered from its coordinate.
items.title: rotationMatrix_coordinate

items.label: complexIsometry_apply_mul_exp
items.statement:
Under `complexIsometry`, a complex polar vector is the standard planar rotation of the
first coordinate vector, scaled by its radius.
items.title: complexIsometry_apply_mul_exp

items.label: contDiffAt_oangle_toReal_of_pos
items.statement:
The principal real oriented angle is smooth wherever both vectors remain in the positive
first-coordinate chart.
items.title: contDiffAt_oangle_toReal_of_pos

items.label: contDiff_smoothCutoff
items.statement: The planar cutoff is infinitely differentiable.
items.title: contDiff_smoothCutoff

items.label: contDiff_two_indicator_compl_finsum_eqOn_zero_jets
items.statement:
In the Euclidean plane, the same supportwise decay certificate also gives vanishing
gradient and operator-valued Hessian on the closed cluster set.
items.title: contDiff_two_indicator_compl_finsum_eqOn_zero_jets

items.label: det_hessianMatrix
items.statement: The determinant of the Hessian matrix equals the determinant of the Hessian linear map.
items.title: det_hessianMatrix

items.label: det_rotationMatrix
items.statement: The explicit rotation matrix has determinant one.
items.title: det_rotationMatrix

items.label: eq_frame_firstColumn_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
items.statement:
A real `2 × 2` special orthogonal matrix is the positively oriented frame
generated by its first column.
items.title: eq_frame_firstColumn_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup

items.label: frame_eq_rotationMatrix_oangle
items.statement:
A unit frame is the rotation matrix of the oriented angle from the first
standard basis vector.
items.title: frame_eq_rotationMatrix_oangle

items.label: frame_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff
items.statement:
The frame `(e, perp e)` is positively oriented orthonormal exactly when
`e` is a unit vector.
items.title: frame_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff

items.label: frame_mulVec
items.statement: Frame coordinates reconstruct the corresponding linear combination of `e` and `perp e`.
items.title: frame_mulVec

items.label: gradient_comp_linearIsometry
items.statement: The gradient transforms contravariantly under an orthogonal change of frame.
items.title: gradient_comp_linearIsometry

items.label: hasCompactSupport_smoothCutoff
items.statement: The planar cutoff has compact topological support.
items.title: hasCompactSupport_smoothCutoff

items.label: hasHessianBoundsAt_iff_hessianMatrix
items.statement:
Pointwise operator-valued Hessian bounds are equivalent to the corresponding lower and
upper positive-semidefinite bounds on the Euclidean-plane Hessian matrix.
items.title: hasHessianBoundsAt_iff_hessianMatrix

items.label: hasHessianBounds_iff_hessianMatrix
items.statement:
Global operator-valued Hessian bounds are equivalent to pointwise lower and upper
positive-semidefinite bounds on every Euclidean-plane Hessian matrix.
items.title: hasHessianBounds_iff_hessianMatrix

items.label: hessianMatrix_apply
items.statement: Applying the Hessian agrees in canonical coordinates with multiplying by its Hessian matrix.
items.title: hessianMatrix_apply

items.label: hessianMatrix_isHermitian
items.statement: At a point where `f` is `C²`, its Hessian matrix is Hermitian, hence symmetric over `ℝ`.
items.title: hessianMatrix_isHermitian

items.label: hessianMatrix_sqNorm_add_bounds_of_norm_le
items.statement:
A norm bound on the perturbation Hessian bounds the Hessian matrix of half the squared
distance plus the perturbation between the corresponding scalar identity matrices.
items.title: hessianMatrix_sqNorm_add_bounds_of_norm_le

items.label: hessian_apply_inner
items.statement:
Pairing the operator-valued Hessian with a direction recovers the second iterated
Fréchet derivative.
items.title: hessian_apply_inner

items.label: hessian_comp_linearIsometry
items.statement: The Hessian transforms by orthogonal conjugation under a change of frame.
items.title: hessian_comp_linearIsometry

items.label: hessian_def
items.statement: The operator-valued Hessian unfolds to the Fréchet derivative of the gradient.
items.title: hessian_def

items.label: hessian_eq_genericHessian
items.statement:
The Euclidean-plane Hessian agrees with the generic operator-valued Hessian on the
Euclidean plane.
items.title: hessian_eq_genericHessian

items.label: hessian_indicator_compl_eqOn_zero
items.statement:
The operator-valued Hessian of a planar zero extension vanishes identically on the
closed set under the second-order value and first-derivative decay assumptions.
items.title: hessian_indicator_compl_eqOn_zero

items.label: hessian_indicator_compl_eq_zero_of_mem
items.statement:
A zero extension across a closed subset of the Euclidean plane has vanishing operator-valued
Hessian at every boundary point under the usual second-order value and first-derivative decay.
items.title: hessian_indicator_compl_eq_zero_of_mem

items.label: hessian_isSelfAdjoint
items.statement: At a point where `f` is `C²`, its operator-valued Hessian is self-adjoint.
items.title: hessian_isSelfAdjoint

items.label: hessian_sqNorm_add
items.statement:
The Hessian of half the squared distance from `C` plus `Ψ` is the identity operator plus
the Hessian of `Ψ`.
items.title: hessian_sqNorm_add

items.label: lowerBound_hessianMatrix_iff
items.statement:
A lower Loewner bound on the Hessian matrix is equivalent to the corresponding quadratic-form
bound on the Hessian operator.
items.title: lowerBound_hessianMatrix_iff

items.label: norm_fderiv_smoothCutoff_le
items.statement: The first derivative of the planar cutoff is globally bounded by its order-one bound.
items.title: norm_fderiv_smoothCutoff_le

items.label: norm_firstColumn_eq_one_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
items.statement:
The first column of a real `2 × 2` special orthogonal matrix has Euclidean
norm one.
items.title: norm_firstColumn_eq_one_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_smoothCutoff_le
items.statement:
The `n`-th iterated derivative of the planar cutoff is globally bounded by
its supremum-defined bound.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_smoothCutoff_le

items.label: norm_secondFDeriv_smoothCutoff_le
items.statement: The second derivative of the planar cutoff is globally bounded by its order-two bound.
items.title: norm_secondFDeriv_smoothCutoff_le

items.label: norm_smoothCutoff_le
items.statement: The values of the planar cutoff are globally bounded by its order-zero bound.
items.title: norm_smoothCutoff_le

items.label: oangle_frame_mulVec
items.statement:
Applying the same positively oriented unit frame to two coordinate vectors preserves
their oriented angle.
items.title: oangle_frame_mulVec

items.label: oangle_frame_mulVec_toReal_eq_arctan_sub_of_pos
items.statement:
In a positively oriented unit frame, the principal real oriented angle is the
difference of the arctangents of the two coordinate slopes.
items.title: oangle_frame_mulVec_toReal_eq_arctan_sub_of_pos

items.label: oangle_specialOrthogonal_mulVec
items.statement:
Simultaneously applying a real `2 × 2` special orthogonal matrix preserves
the oriented angle between two coordinate vectors.
items.title: oangle_specialOrthogonal_mulVec

items.label: oangle_toReal_eq_arctan_sub_of_pos
items.statement:
For two planar vectors whose first coordinates are positive, the principal real
representative of their oriented angle is the difference of their arctangent slope coordinates.
items.title: oangle_toReal_eq_arctan_sub_of_pos

items.label: perp_apply
items.statement: The right-angle operator sends `(x₁, x₂)` to `(-x₂, x₁)`.
items.title: perp_apply

items.label: polarDistance_ge_max_principal_sub_errors
items.statement:
Two planar points close to polar vectors about a common center inherit the maximum of the
radial and principal angular separation bounds, up to their two approximation errors.
items.title: polarDistance_ge_max_principal_sub_errors

items.label: rotationMatrix_mulVec
items.statement: Matrix-vector multiplication by `rotationMatrix` agrees with the bundled rotation.
items.title: rotationMatrix_mulVec

items.label: rotation_apply
items.statement:
Rotation in the standard Euclidean plane is the cosine-sine combination of a vector and
its positively oriented perpendicular.
items.title: rotation_apply

items.label: smoothCutoffDerivBound_nonneg
items.statement: Every iterated-derivative bound of the planar cutoff is nonnegative.
items.title: smoothCutoffDerivBound_nonneg

items.label: smoothCutoff_eq_one
items.statement: The planar cutoff equals one on the closed ball of radius one third.
items.title: smoothCutoff_eq_one

items.label: toEuclideanCLM_hessianMatrix
items.statement: Converting the Hessian matrix back to a Euclidean continuous linear map recovers the Hessian.
items.title: toEuclideanCLM_hessianMatrix

items.label: toMatrix_rotation
items.statement: The matrix of the bundled rotation in the standard Euclidean basis is `rotationMatrix`.
items.title: toMatrix_rotation

items.label: tsupport_smoothCutoff_subset
items.statement: The topological support of the planar cutoff lies in the open unit ball.
items.title: tsupport_smoothCutoff_subset

items.label: upperBound_hessianMatrix_iff
items.statement:
An upper Loewner bound on the Hessian matrix is equivalent to the corresponding quadratic-form
bound on the Hessian operator.
items.title: upperBound_hessianMatrix_iff

items.label: contDiff_objective
items.statement:
Adding a half squared norm on an orthogonal summand preserves twice continuous
differentiability.
items.title: contDiff_objective

items.label: differentiableAt_objective_inl_iff
items.statement:
Differentiability of the lifted objective at an embedded point is equivalent
to differentiability of the original objective.
items.title: differentiableAt_objective_inl_iff

items.label: gradient_objective
items.statement:
The gradient of the orthogonal-sum objective at an arbitrary point consists of the
left gradient and the current right coordinate.
items.title: gradient_objective

items.label: gradient_objective_inl
items.statement:
At an embedded point, the gradient of the orthogonal-sum objective is the embedded
gradient of the original objective.
items.title: gradient_objective_inl

items.label: hasGradientAt_objective
items.statement:
A certified gradient of the left objective and the current right coordinate combine to
the gradient of the orthogonal-sum objective at an arbitrary point.
items.title: hasGradientAt_objective

items.label: hasGradientAt_objective_inl
items.statement: A certified gradient embeds as a certified gradient of the orthogonal-sum objective.
items.title: hasGradientAt_objective_inl

items.label: hasHessianBounds_objective
items.statement:
If the original Hessian lies between `m I` and `M I`, adjoining an identity quadratic
block preserves those bounds whenever `m ≤ 1 ≤ M`.
items.title: hasHessianBounds_objective

items.label: hessianHolder_objective
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: adjoining an identity quadratic block preserves a
global Hölder Hessian bound with the same exponent and constant.
items.title: hessianHolder_objective

items.label: hessian_objective_apply
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the Hessian of an objective extended by an identity
quadratic acts separately on its two orthogonal coordinates.
items.title: hessian_objective_apply

items.label: inner_eq_left_add_right
items.statement:
The inner product on a Euclidean orthogonal sum is the sum of the inner products of
its two coordinate projections.
items.title: inner_eq_left_add_right

items.label: inner_inl_left
items.statement:
Pairing a left-embedded vector with an arbitrary direct-sum vector depends only on the
left projection.
items.title: inner_inl_left

items.label: left_inl
items.statement: Projecting a left-embedded vector onto the left coordinates recovers it.
items.title: left_inl

items.label: left_sumEquivProd_symm
items.statement:
The left projection of a vector reconstructed from orthogonal-sum coordinates is its
left coordinate.
items.title: left_sumEquivProd_symm

items.label: norm_hessian_objective_sub_le
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the variable part of the extended Hessian is supported
on the original coordinates, so its difference has no larger operator norm.
items.title: norm_hessian_objective_sub_le

items.label: norm_hessian_sub_le_objective
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: restriction to the original
coordinates recovers a lower bound for the extended Hessian difference norm.
items.title: norm_hessian_sub_le_objective

items.label: norm_left_le
items.statement: Helper for thm:main: an orthogonal coordinate projection does not increase norm.
items.title: norm_left_le

items.label: norm_sq_eq_left_add_right
items.statement:
The squared norm on a Euclidean orthogonal sum is the sum of the squared norms of its
two coordinate projections.
items.title: norm_sq_eq_left_add_right

items.label: objective_apply
items.statement:
Evaluation of the objective obtained by adjoining a half squared norm on the right
orthogonal summand.
items.title: objective_apply

items.label: objective_inl
items.statement: The orthogonal-sum objective restricts to the original objective on the left summand.
items.title: objective_inl

items.label: right_inl
items.statement: Projecting a left-embedded vector onto the right coordinates gives zero.
items.title: right_inl

items.label: right_sumEquivProd_symm
items.statement:
The right projection of a vector reconstructed from orthogonal-sum coordinates is its
right coordinate.
items.title: right_sumEquivProd_symm

items.label: toDual_inl
items.statement:
The Riesz dual of a left-embedded vector is the original Riesz dual composed with the
left projection.
items.title: toDual_inl

items.label: extendMatrix_apply_inl_inl
items.statement: The upper-left block of `extendMatrix H` is `H`.
items.title: extendMatrix_apply_inl_inl

items.label: extendMatrix_apply_inl_inr
items.statement: The upper-right block of `extendMatrix H` vanishes.
items.title: extendMatrix_apply_inl_inr

items.label: extendMatrix_apply_inr_inl
items.statement: The lower-left block of `extendMatrix H` vanishes.
items.title: extendMatrix_apply_inr_inl

items.label: extendMatrix_apply_inr_inr
items.statement: The lower-right block of `extendMatrix H` is the identity.
items.title: extendMatrix_apply_inr_inr

items.label: extendMatrix_mulVec_inl
items.statement:
The identity-block extension acts on a left-embedded vector by the embedded
original matrix action.
items.title: extendMatrix_mulVec_inl

items.label: extendMatrix_posDef_iff
items.statement:
Extending a real square matrix by an identity block preserves and reflects positive
definiteness. This statement does not require either index type to be finite.
items.title: extendMatrix_posDef_iff

items.label: inl_apply_inl
items.statement: The left coordinates of the canonical left-summand embedding are unchanged.
items.title: inl_apply_inl

items.label: inl_apply_inr
items.statement: The right coordinates of the canonical left-summand embedding vanish.
items.title: inl_apply_inr

items.label: inner_inl
items.statement: The canonical left-summand embedding preserves the real inner product.
items.title: inner_inl

items.label: norm_inl
items.statement: The canonical left-summand embedding is an isometry.
items.title: norm_inl

items.label: quadraticForm_extendMatrix
items.statement:
The quadratic form of an identity-block extension splits as the original quadratic
form plus a sum of squares.
items.title: quadraticForm_extendMatrix

items.label: tendsto_norm_div_infDist_of_sq
items.statement:
Quadratic decay relative to the distance from a set implies the corresponding
first-order decay along the same distance filter.
items.title: tendsto_norm_div_infDist_of_sq

items.label: exists_pos_le
items.statement:
A finite family of positive elements in a linear order has a common positive
lower bound below any prescribed positive bound.
items.title: exists_pos_le

items.label: add
items.statement:
Uniform finite jets are closed under pointwise addition at a common input
base.
items.title: add

items.label: boundedCoeff
items.statement:
A uniform finite jet family has uniformly bounded coefficients in every
degree through `m`.
items.title: boundedCoeff

items.label: comp
items.statement:
Uniform finite jets compose when the inner family sends its common base to
the common expansion base of the outer family.
items.title: comp

items.label: congr
items.statement:
Uniformity is unchanged when both the function family and jet family agree
on the parameter set under consideration.
items.title: congr

items.label: eventually_cubic_bound_of_coeff_zero
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable
contraction): a uniform cubic estimate on a parameter neighborhood becomes an eventual
estimate on the product neighborhood of `(0, theta0)`.
items.title: eventually_cubic_bound_of_coeff_zero

items.label: exists_cubic_bound_of_coeff_zero
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable contraction):
a uniform order-three scalar jet whose coefficients of degrees zero, one, and two vanish
is uniformly bounded by a constant times `‖h ^ 3‖`.  The same estimate supplies the
cubic transverse-factor bound required by Supporting Lemma.
items.title: exists_cubic_bound_of_coeff_zero

items.label: exists_one_le_coeff_bound
items.statement:
All coefficients in a uniform finite jet family admit one common bound of
size at least one.
items.title: exists_one_le_coeff_bound

items.label: inv
items.statement:
Reciprocal postcomposition preserves a real uniform finite jet family when
all constant coefficients equal one nonzero base value.
items.title: inv

items.label: mul
items.statement:
Uniform finite jets with values in a normed real algebra are closed under
pointwise multiplication.
items.title: mul

items.label: norm
items.statement:
Norm postcomposition preserves uniform finite jets in a real inner product
space when all constant coefficients equal one nonzero vector.
items.title: norm

items.label: remainder
items.statement:
A uniform finite jet family supplies an order-`m` remainder estimate with
every prescribed positive coefficient.
items.title: remainder

items.label: scalarRemainder_isLittleO
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable
contraction): a scalar member of a uniform jet family has a pointwise Peano remainder.
items.title: scalarRemainder_isLittleO

items.label: spec
items.statement:
The defining coefficient-boundedness and every-positive-coefficient
remainder characterization of a uniform finite jet family.
items.title: spec

items.label: sqrt
items.statement:
Square-root postcomposition preserves a real uniform finite jet family when
all constant coefficients equal one positive base value.
items.title: sqrt

items.label: value_eq_constantCoeff
items.statement:
At every parameter in the uniformity set, the function value at the base
equals the constant coefficient of its jet.
items.title: value_eq_constantCoeff

items.label: weightedPath
items.statement:
Restriction along `ε ↦ (ε, ε ^ 2)` turns a uniform two-variable finite jet
family at `(0, 0)` into a uniform one-variable jet family at zero.
items.title: weightedPath

items.label: along
items.statement:
Restrict a multivariable uniform jet remainder along uniformly bounded
scalar directions to obtain the scalar-path remainder predicate.
items.title: along

items.label: bound
items.statement:
A uniform jet remainder supplies an explicit common positive radius and its
associated bound.
items.title: bound

items.label: spec
items.statement: The defining common-radius characterization of a uniform jet remainder.
items.title: spec

items.label: ambientOrder_pos_of_index_pos
items.statement:
Supporting fact: positivity of a retained coefficient implies positivity
of the ambient finite-jet order.
items.title: ambientOrder_pos_of_index_pos

items.label: analytic_mixed_cubic_quartic_isBigO
items.statement:
An analytic map has no mixed terms through degree four along a linear direction
and a cubic-quartic perturbation if its quadratic cross derivative in the linear and
cubic directions vanishes.
items.title: analytic_mixed_cubic_quartic_isBigO

items.label: coeff_add
items.statement: Coefficients of a sum jet are sums of the corresponding coefficients.
items.title: coeff_add

items.label: coeff_comp
items.statement:
A coefficient of a composed jet is the corresponding coefficient of the
normalized formal-series composition.
items.title: coeff_comp

items.label: coeff_comp_ofFunction_scalar
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable
contraction): every coefficient of a scalar formal jet composition is the corresponding
coefficient of the derivative-constructed composite jet.
items.title: coeff_comp_ofFunction_scalar

items.label: coeff_ofFunction
items.statement:
The coefficients constructed by `ofFunction` are the normalized iterated
Fréchet derivatives.
items.title: coeff_ofFunction

items.label: coeff_ofFunction_apply
items.statement:
Evaluating a coefficient constructed by `ofFunction` evaluates the
corresponding factorial-normalized iterated Fréchet derivative.
items.title: coeff_ofFunction_apply

items.label: coeff_prod
items.statement: Coefficients of a paired jet are Cartesian products of coefficients.
items.title: coeff_prod

items.label: coeff_truncate
items.statement: Truncation retains every coefficient of degree at most `m`.
items.title: coeff_truncate

items.label: coeff_weightedPathJet
items.statement:
Coefficients of the weighted-path jet are its factorial-normalized iterated
Fréchet derivatives at zero.
items.title: coeff_weightedPathJet

items.label: comp_coeff_branch_split
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a finite-jet composition coefficient splits into a chosen
composition branch and the finite sum of all remaining branches.
items.title: comp_coeff_branch_split

items.label: comp_coeff_eq_of_eq_below
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a finite-jet composition coefficient is unchanged when
the outer coefficients and positive inner coefficients agree through that order.
items.title: comp_coeff_eq_of_eq_below

items.label: comp_coeff_eq_zero_of_inner_coeff_eq_zero
items.statement:
Supporting fact: if every positive inner coefficient through a retained
order vanishes, the corresponding coefficient of any finite-jet composition vanishes.
items.title: comp_coeff_eq_zero_of_inner_coeff_eq_zero

items.label: comp_coeff_eq_zero_of_outer_coeff_eq_zero
items.statement:
Supporting fact: if every outer coefficient of a finite
Taylor jet vanishes, every coefficient of its composition vanishes.
items.title: comp_coeff_eq_zero_of_outer_coeff_eq_zero

items.label: comp_coeff_eq_zero_of_outer_coeff_eq_zero_below
items.statement:
Supporting fact: vanishing outer coefficients through a target order
forces the corresponding composition coefficient to vanish.
items.title: comp_coeff_eq_zero_of_outer_coeff_eq_zero_below

items.label: comp_coeff_outer_ones_apply
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating an all-ones outer branch at an arbitrary
retained coefficient exposes the outer coefficient at that branch length and the repeated
inner linear coefficient.
items.title: comp_coeff_outer_ones_apply

items.label: comp_coeff_outer_ones_apply_eq_coeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: an arbitrary all-ones branch evaluated on a repeated input
is exactly the outer coefficient gap applied to repeated inner linear coefficients.
items.title: comp_coeff_outer_ones_apply_eq_coeff

items.label: comp_coeff_sub_decompose_through_projections
items.statement:
Supporting fact: simultaneous inner and outer coefficient changes split into
the inner one-block term, the projected inner residual, the outer all-ones branch, and the
projected outer residual at any positive retained order.
items.title: comp_coeff_sub_decompose_through_projections

items.label: comp_coeff_sub_eq_inner
items.statement:
Supporting fact: at a positive retained order, agreement of two inner jets
below that order leaves only the one-block composition branch.
items.title: comp_coeff_sub_eq_inner

items.label: comp_coeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq
items.statement:
Supporting fact: when two inner jets have the same linear coefficient, an
arbitrary positive composition coefficient difference is exactly the sum of its non-all-ones
branches.
items.title: comp_coeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq

items.label: comp_coeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the arbitrary positive non-all-ones
composition difference on a repeated input commutes with the finite branch sum.
items.title: comp_coeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply

items.label: comp_coeff_sub_eq_outer
items.statement:
Supporting fact: at a positive retained order, agreement of two outer jets
below that order leaves only the all-ones composition branch.
items.title: comp_coeff_sub_eq_outer

items.label: comp_coeff_sub_eq_outer_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: replacing an outer jet through an arbitrary retained
coefficient isolates its all-ones branch from the residual with the projected outer jet.
items.title: comp_coeff_sub_eq_outer_through_topProjection

items.label: comp_comp_coeff_sub_apply_eq_outer_of_lower
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a nested scalar composition evaluates the outer
coefficient gap on the inner linear coefficient after the scalar reindexing linear coefficient.
items.title: comp_comp_coeff_sub_apply_eq_outer_of_lower

items.label: comp_eval_sub_eval_eq_highDegreeSum
items.statement:
The discrepancy between nested jet evaluation and truncated composition is
the finite sum of composition terms whose total degree exceeds the cutoff.
items.title: comp_eval_sub_eval_eq_highDegreeSum

items.label: comp_ofFunction_one
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure (Finite-order graph-jet contraction):
derivative-constructed jets commute with function composition at order one.
items.title: comp_ofFunction_one

items.label: comp_ofFunction_scalar
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable contraction):
for a scalar source, derivative-constructed finite jets commute with composition in every
finite order.
items.title: comp_ofFunction_scalar

items.label: comp_ofFunction_zero
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (Finite-order graph-jet contraction):
derivative-constructed jets commute with function composition at order zero.
items.title: comp_ofFunction_zero

items.label: comp_partialSum_eq_sum_filter
items.statement:
The partial sum of a formal-series composition is the portion of the
finite composition index set whose total degree is below the cutoff.
items.title: comp_partialSum_eq_sum_filter

items.label: comp_prod_comp_coeff_sub_eq_inner_of_lower
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a lower-equal product-valued inner variation passes through
an outer jet and a scalar reindexing jet at an arbitrary positive retained coefficient.
items.title: comp_prod_comp_coeff_sub_eq_inner_of_lower

items.label: comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_of_lower
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a lower-equal fiber-jet variation passes
through a product-valued inner jet and a scalar reindexing jet at the repeated-one
top coefficient.
items.title: comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_of_lower

items.label: comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_of_zeroTop
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a product inner jet with a zero-top projection
isolates the fiber top coefficient through two nested finite-jet compositions.
items.title: comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_of_zeroTop

items.label: comp_topCoeff_branch_split
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the top coefficient branch sum splits into a chosen
composition branch and the finite sum of all remaining branches.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_branch_split

items.label: comp_topCoeff_branch_sum
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the top coefficient of a finite jet composition is the
finite sum of its formal-series composition branches.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_branch_sum

items.label: comp_topCoeff_nonOnes_eq_zeroTopReplacement
items.statement:
Supporting fact: replacing an outer jet's top coefficient by zero
isolates the non-all-ones branches of its top composition coefficient.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_nonOnes_eq_zeroTopReplacement

items.label: comp_topCoeff_outer_ones_apply
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the all-ones outer branch on a
constant direction exposes the outer coefficient at the branch length and the
repeated inner linear coefficient.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_outer_ones_apply

items.label: comp_topCoeff_outer_ones_eq_zero_of_topCoeff_eq
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the all-ones outer branch vanishes when two
outer finite jets have the same top coefficient.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_outer_ones_eq_zero_of_topCoeff_eq

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_eq_inner_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the projected top-coefficient identity on a
repeated direction preserves the outer linear term and the projected residual term.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_eq_inner_through_topProjection

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_decompose
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a top-coefficient secant of two finite
compositions splits through the mixed composition obtained by changing the
inner jet first and the outer jet second.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_decompose

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_decompose_through_projections
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a two-sided top-coefficient secant splits into
the inner linear term, the projected inner residual, the outer all-ones term,
and the projected outer residual.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_decompose_through_projections

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner
items.statement:
Supporting fact: if two inner jets agree below a positive top order,
the top coefficient of their common outer composition is the outer linear map
applied to the difference of their top coefficients.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_through_replacedTopCoeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the top-coefficient secant identity can
use the canonical jet obtained by replacing the source top coefficient.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_through_replacedTopCoeff

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: replacing an inner jet by a projected jet
isolates the outer linear top-order term and the remaining projected composition.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_inner_through_topProjection

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq
items.statement:
Supporting fact: when two inner jets have the same linear
coefficient, their top-composition difference is exactly the sum of the
non-all-ones branch differences.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the all-ones-cancelled top
coefficient difference on a repeated input commutes with the non-ones sum.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_outer
items.statement:
Supporting fact: if two outer jets agree below the top order, the top
coefficient of their common inner composition is exactly the all-ones branch
of the outer formal-series difference.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_outer

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_outer_through_replacedTopCoeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the outer top-coefficient secant identity
uses the canonical jet obtained by replacing the outer source top coefficient.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_outer_through_replacedTopCoeff

items.label: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_outer_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: replacing only the top outer coefficient
isolates the all-ones branch from the remaining equal-top composition residual.
items.title: comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_outer_through_topProjection

items.label: compactContDiffAtTube
items.statement:
Pointwise finite-order differentiability along a compact fiber holds on
one common tube around that fiber.
items.title: compactContDiffAtTube

items.label: compactFiberEventually
items.statement:
Pointwise product-neighborhood control over a compact second factor becomes
uniform control in the first factor.
items.title: compactFiberEventually

items.label: compactFiberNormRadius
items.statement:
Product-neighborhood control over a compact parameter set holds on one
positive norm ball in the increment variable.
items.title: compactFiberNormRadius

items.label: compactIteratedFDerivOscillation
items.statement:
On a compact fiber, the top iterated derivative has one common radius on
which its variation in the second coordinate is uniformly small.
items.title: compactIteratedFDerivOscillation

items.label: compactValueOscillation
items.statement:
A function continuous along a compact fiber varies uniformly little in
the second coordinate on one common norm ball.
items.title: compactValueOscillation

items.label: constantCoeff_apply
items.statement: The constant coefficient is evaluation at the zero increment.
items.title: constantCoeff_apply

items.label: constantCoeff_comp
items.statement:
Supporting fact: composing finite Taylor jets preserves the constant
coefficient of the outer jet.
items.title: constantCoeff_comp

items.label: constantCoeff_eq_coeff_zero
items.statement: Evaluation at zero retains exactly the degree-zero coefficient of a finite jet.
items.title: constantCoeff_eq_coeff_zero

items.label: constantCoeff_ofFunction
items.statement:
The constant coefficient of the derivative-constructed jet is the value of
the function at its expansion base.
items.title: constantCoeff_ofFunction

items.label: contDiffOne_comp_coeff
items.statement:
Coefficientwise `C¹` scalar-source finite jets remain coefficientwise
`C¹` after finite Taylor composition.
items.title: contDiffOne_comp_coeff

items.label: contDiffOne_multilinearMap_of_apply_one
items.statement:
A scalar-source multilinear-map family is `C¹` when its value on the
all-ones vector is `C¹`.
items.title: contDiffOne_multilinearMap_of_apply_one

items.label: continuous_comp_coeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: coefficientwise continuous scalar-source
jets remain coefficientwise continuous under finite Taylor composition.
items.title: continuous_comp_coeff

items.label: continuous_constantCoeff_of_coeff_zero
items.statement:
Supporting fact: continuity of degree-zero coefficient maps
implies continuity of the corresponding constant-coefficient family.
items.title: continuous_constantCoeff_of_coeff_zero

items.label: continuous_multilinearMap_of_apply_one
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a family of multilinear maps is continuous
when its evaluation on the all-ones vector is continuous.
items.title: continuous_multilinearMap_of_apply_one

items.label: continuous_ofFunction_coeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: coefficients of a finite jet built from a
smooth map vary continuously with the base point.
items.title: continuous_ofFunction_coeff

items.label: continuous_prod_coeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: coefficientwise continuous families of
finite jets remain coefficientwise continuous after pairing their values.
items.title: continuous_prod_coeff

items.label: continuous_scalarCoeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: scalar evaluation of a continuous
one-variable coefficient family is continuous.
items.title: continuous_scalarCoeff

items.label: deriv_comp_add_smul_of_differentiableAt
items.statement:
Differentiating a function along an affine line applies its Fréchet
derivative to the line direction.
items.title: deriv_comp_add_smul_of_differentiableAt

items.label: deriv_iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_smul
items.statement:
The derivative of a diagonal evaluation of an iterated Fréchet derivative
along a line is the next diagonal iterated derivative.
items.title: deriv_iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_smul

items.label: eq_iff_coeff_eq
items.statement: Equality of finite Taylor jets is coefficientwise equality.
items.title: eq_iff_coeff_eq

items.label: eq_of_eval_sub_isLittleO
items.statement:
Two one-variable finite jets are equal when the difference of their evaluations is
little-o of the top retained monomial.
items.title: eq_of_eval_sub_isLittleO

items.label: eq_replaceTopCoeff_of_coeff_eq
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a jet with the prescribed lower
coefficients and top coefficient is the corresponding top replacement.
items.title: eq_replaceTopCoeff_of_coeff_eq

items.label: eval_add
items.statement: Evaluation of a sum jet is the sum of the evaluations.
items.title: eval_add

items.label: eval_comp_eq_partialSum_comp
items.statement:
Evaluation of a truncated composition is the corresponding low-degree
partial sum of the untruncated formal-series composition.
items.title: eval_comp_eq_partialSum_comp

items.label: eval_eq_partialSum
items.statement: Jet evaluation agrees with the canonical partial sum of its zero extension.
items.title: eval_eq_partialSum

items.label: eval_eq_sum
items.statement: Evaluation is the finite sum of the diagonal coefficient values.
items.title: eval_eq_sum

items.label: eval_eq_sum_smul_scalarCoeff
items.statement:
For a one-variable jet, evaluation is the power sum of its scalar
coefficients.
items.title: eval_eq_sum_smul_scalarCoeff

items.label: eval_ofFunction_zero
items.statement: The order-zero derivative jet evaluates to the base value at every increment.
items.title: eval_ofFunction_zero

items.label: eval_of_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall
items.statement:
A convergent analytic power series evaluates the derivative-constructed jet
as its corresponding finite partial sum.
items.title: eval_of_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall

items.label: eval_sub_constantCoeff_eq_sum_Ico
items.statement:
Subtracting a jet's constant coefficient leaves exactly its positive-degree
formal-series partial sum.
items.title: eval_sub_constantCoeff_eq_sum_Ico

items.label: eventually_cubic_bound_of_contDiffAt_of_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable
contraction): if the compact parameter set is also a neighborhood of `theta0`, the uniform
cubic derivative estimate holds eventually near `(0, theta0)`.
items.title: eventually_cubic_bound_of_contDiffAt_of_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero

items.label: exists_compEvalTailBound
items.statement:
Uniform coefficient bounds give a uniform order-`m+1` bound for the
high-degree tail discarded by finite-jet composition on the unit ball.
items.title: exists_compEvalTailBound

items.label: exists_cubic_bound_of_contDiffAt_of_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero
items.statement:
Supporting infrastructure (Finite-smooth invariant graph under an explicit stable contraction):
a jointly `C³` scalar-input family on a compact parameter set is uniformly cubic when its
slice derivatives of orders zero, one, and two vanish.  This also supplies the finite-jet
form of the transverse cubic estimate required by Supporting Lemma.
items.title: exists_cubic_bound_of_contDiffAt_of_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero

items.label: ext_coeff
items.statement: A finite Taylor jet is determined coefficientwise.
items.title: ext_coeff

items.label: firstSecondIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero_of_isBigO_cube
items.statement:
Supporting fact: companion: a twice continuously differentiable scalar-input
map that is `O(ε³)` has vanishing first and second iterated Fréchet derivatives at zero.
items.title: firstSecondIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero_of_isBigO_cube

items.label: inv_def
items.statement: Reciprocal jets are obtained by postcomposition with inversion.
items.title: inv_def

items.label: isUniformOn_of_contDiff
items.statement:
A jointly `C^m` family on a compact parameter set produces a uniform family
of derivative-constructed order-`m` finite jets at every fixed input base.
items.title: isUniformOn_of_contDiff

items.label: isUniformOn_of_contDiffAt
items.statement:
Joint finite-order differentiability at every point of a compact parameter fiber
produces a uniform family of derivative-constructed finite jets at the fixed input base.
items.title: isUniformOn_of_contDiffAt

items.label: iteratedDeriv_comp_add_smul
items.statement:
Iterated derivatives of an affine-line restriction are diagonal evaluations
of the corresponding iterated Fréchet derivatives.
items.title: iteratedDeriv_comp_add_smul

items.label: iteratedDeriv_factorialInv_pow_smul
items.statement:
The top iterated derivative of a factorial-normalized vector monomial is
the constant vector coefficient.
items.title: iteratedDeriv_factorialInv_pow_smul

items.label: iteratedDeriv_factorialInv_pow_smul_zero
items.statement:
Every derivative below the degree of a factorial-normalized vector
monomial vanishes at zero.
items.title: iteratedDeriv_factorialInv_pow_smul_zero

items.label: iteratedFDeriv_comp_eq_taylorComp
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (finite-order graph-jet contraction): the iterated derivative
of a composite is the Faa di Bruno Taylor composition of the two derivative series.
items.title: iteratedFDeriv_comp_eq_taylorComp

items.label: iteratedFDeriv_slice_eq_comp_inr_at
items.statement:
The derivative of a fixed-parameter slice is the joint derivative restricted
to the canonical right inclusion, assuming only pointwise finite smoothness.
items.title: iteratedFDeriv_slice_eq_comp_inr_at

items.label: mul_def
items.statement:
Multiplication of jets is postcomposition of their paired jet by algebra
multiplication.
items.title: mul_def

items.label: norm_coeff_comp_le
items.statement:
Uniform bounds for the coefficients of two jets bound each coefficient of
their truncated formal-series composition by an explicit finite sum.
items.title: norm_coeff_comp_le

items.label: norm_comp_coeff_outer_ones_le
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the norm of an arbitrary retained all-ones branch is bounded
by the outer coefficient gap times the corresponding power of the inner linear coefficient.
items.title: norm_comp_coeff_outer_ones_le

items.label: norm_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_decompose_through_projections
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the simultaneous projection estimate on a
repeated direction multiplies the four coefficient bounds by the corresponding direction power.
items.title: norm_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_decompose_through_projections

items.label: norm_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_outer_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the arbitrary-order outer projection estimate on a
repeated input contributes exactly the retained-degree power of the input norm.
items.title: norm_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_outer_through_topProjection

items.label: norm_comp_coeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply_le
items.statement:
Supporting fact: branchwise bounds on arbitrary retained non-all-ones
composition terms give a direct norm bound for the coefficient difference.
items.title: norm_comp_coeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply_le

items.label: norm_comp_coeff_sub_le_decompose_through_projections
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the simultaneous arbitrary-order projection decomposition has
a four-term norm estimate, with the two distinguished branches isolated explicitly.
items.title: norm_comp_coeff_sub_le_decompose_through_projections

items.label: norm_comp_coeff_sub_le_outer_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the arbitrary-order outer projection decomposition has a norm
bound given by the all-ones coefficient gap and the projected composition residual.
items.title: norm_comp_coeff_sub_le_outer_through_topProjection

items.label: norm_comp_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_outer_of_lower
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a nested scalar composition transports a lower-equal
outer top-coefficient bound to repeated inputs with explicit inner and reindexing factors.
items.title: norm_comp_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_outer_of_lower

items.label: norm_comp_prod_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_inner_of_lower
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the arbitrary-order product-composition projection has a
repeated-input norm bound separating the scalar reindexing factor, the outer linear coefficient,
and the retained inner coefficient gap.
items.title: norm_comp_prod_comp_coeff_sub_apply_le_inner_of_lower

items.label: norm_comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_of_lower
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the lower-equal product-composition
identity has a repeated-input norm bound separating the reindexing factor,
the inner linear coefficient, and the fiber top-coefficient gap.
items.title: norm_comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_of_lower

items.label: norm_comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_of_zeroTop
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the zero-top projected nested composition is bounded
by the repeated scalar coefficient, the outer linear coefficient, and the fiber top gap.
items.title: norm_comp_prod_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_of_zeroTop

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_outer_ones_apply_le
items.statement:
Supporting fact: evaluating the all-ones composition branch on a repeated
input is bounded by the outer top-coefficient gap and the scaled inner linear coefficient.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_outer_ones_apply_le

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_through_replacedTopCoeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the canonical inner top-coefficient replacement gives
the projected secant estimate after evaluation on a repeated input.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_through_replacedTopCoeff

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the projected inner top-coefficient estimate remains valid
after evaluation on a repeated input, with the expected power of its norm.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_inner_through_topProjection

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_outer_through_replacedTopCoeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the canonical outer top-coefficient replacement gives
the outer secant estimate after evaluation on a repeated input.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_outer_through_replacedTopCoeff

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_outer_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the projected outer top-coefficient estimate remains valid
after evaluation on a repeated input, with the expected power of its norm.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_apply_le_outer_through_topProjection

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply_le
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a branchwise norm bound for the repeated-input
top-coefficient difference after the all-ones branch has been cancelled.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_eq_nonOnes_of_inner_linear_eq_apply_le

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_decompose_through_projections
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the four projected top-coefficient branches
have a norm estimate in which the inner and outer one-block terms are
controlled by their respective coefficient gaps.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_decompose_through_projections

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_inner
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the inner top-coefficient variation is bounded by
the norm of the outer linear coefficient times the inner top-coefficient gap.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_inner

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_inner_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the projected-inner top-coefficient identity
gives a norm estimate with the outer linear coefficient and projected remainder.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_inner_through_topProjection

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_outer
items.statement:
Supporting fact: with a fixed inner jet, the top-coefficient variation
is bounded by the outer top-coefficient gap times the `m`-th power of the
inner linear coefficient norm.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_outer

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_outer_through_replacedTopCoeff
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the canonical outer replacement gives the
outer one-block norm bound together with its projected composition residual.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_outer_through_replacedTopCoeff

items.label: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_outer_through_topProjection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the outer projected top-coefficient identity
admits a norm bound by the outer top gap and the projected residual.
items.title: norm_comp_topCoeff_sub_le_outer_through_topProjection

items.label: norm_continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_apply_zero_pair_le
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a one-variable curry of a multilinear map
is bounded on a pair with zero first component by the map norm times the
second-component norm.
items.title: norm_continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_apply_zero_pair_le

items.label: norm_def
items.statement: Norm jets are obtained by postcomposition with the norm function.
items.title: norm_def

items.label: norm_eval_sub_eval_le
items.statement:
The change in a finite jet evaluation is bounded by its coefficient norms
and the distance between the two inputs.
items.title: norm_eval_sub_eval_le

items.label: norm_formalSub_onesLength
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the all-ones composition selects the top finite-jet
coefficient of a formal-series difference after taking norms.
items.title: norm_formalSub_onesLength

items.label: norm_formal_onesProduct
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the norms of the inner factors selected by an
all-ones composition multiply to the power of the inner linear coefficient.
items.title: norm_formal_onesProduct

items.label: norm_formal_onesProduct_general
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the all-ones blocks at an arbitrary retained degree select
the inner linear coefficient, so their norms multiply to the retained-degree power.
items.title: norm_formal_onesProduct_general

items.label: norm_iteratedDeriv_radial_sub_le
items.statement:
An operator-norm oscillation bound for a joint iterated derivative bounds
the corresponding scalar radial derivative difference.
items.title: norm_iteratedDeriv_radial_sub_le

items.label: norm_taylorRemainder_le_of_iteratedFDerivOscillation
items.statement:
Oscillation of the top joint derivative along a radial segment controls
the successor-order Taylor-jet remainder of the corresponding slice.
items.title: norm_taylorRemainder_le_of_iteratedFDerivOscillation

items.label: norm_toFormalMultilinearSeries_le
items.statement:
A degreewise bound on a finite jet also bounds every retained coefficient
of its zero-extended formal multilinear series.
items.title: norm_toFormalMultilinearSeries_le

items.label: ofFunction_add_congr
items.statement: Equality of two pairs of one-variable jets is preserved by pointwise addition.
items.title: ofFunction_add_congr

items.label: ofFunction_coeff_comp_eq_taylorComp
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (finite-order graph-jet contraction): a derivative-constructed
jet coefficient of a composite is the factorial-normalized Faa di Bruno coefficient.
items.title: ofFunction_coeff_comp_eq_taylorComp

items.label: ofFunction_comp_cubic_quartic
items.statement:
Along a path whose first nonconstant terms have degrees three and four, the
four-jet of an analytic map only sees its value and first derivative at the base point.
items.title: ofFunction_comp_cubic_quartic

items.label: ofFunction_comp_eq_normalizedTaylorCompJet
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (finite-order graph-jet contraction): under finite
smoothness, the derivative-constructed composite jet is the normalized Faa di Bruno jet.
items.title: ofFunction_comp_eq_normalizedTaylorCompJet

items.label: ofFunction_composite_coeff_sub_decompose
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (finite-order graph-jet contraction): a composite secant
coefficient splits into an inner-map variation followed by an outer-map variation at the
Faa di Bruno Taylor-series level.
items.title: ofFunction_composite_coeff_sub_decompose

items.label: ofFunction_composite_coeff_sub_eq_taylorComp_sub
items.statement:
Supporting fact: (finite-order graph-jet contraction): a secant of
derivative-constructed composite coefficients is the factorial-normalized secant of the
corresponding Faa di Bruno Taylor compositions.
items.title: ofFunction_composite_coeff_sub_eq_taylorComp_sub

items.label: ofFunction_eq_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq
items.statement:
Two derivative-constructed one-variable jets agree exactly when their
iterated derivatives agree through the truncation order.
items.title: ofFunction_eq_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq

items.label: ofFunction_eq_of_eventuallyEq
items.statement: Functions equal in a neighborhood of their common base have equal finite Taylor jets there.
items.title: ofFunction_eq_of_eventuallyEq

items.label: ofFunction_eq_of_sub_isBigO_succ
items.statement: A difference of order `O(h ^ (m + 1))` is invisible to the order-`m` finite jets.
items.title: ofFunction_eq_of_sub_isBigO_succ

items.label: ofFunction_eq_of_sub_isLittleO
items.statement:
If two `C^m` one-variable functions, based at possibly different points, differ by
`o(h ^ m)` after translation to zero, then their order-`m` finite jets agree.
items.title: ofFunction_eq_of_sub_isLittleO

items.label: ofFunction_eq_zeroFunction_iff
items.statement:
The finite jet of a one-variable function is the zero-function jet exactly
when all iterated derivatives through the truncation order vanish.
items.title: ofFunction_eq_zeroFunction_iff

items.label: ofFunction_prodMk
items.statement: The finite jet of a product-valued function is the product of its component jets.
items.title: ofFunction_prodMk

items.label: ofFunction_prodMk_eq_zero
items.statement: A product of two functions with zero finite jets again has zero finite jet.
items.title: ofFunction_prodMk_eq_zero

items.label: ofFunction_split_of_isBigO_succ
items.statement:
If `f = s + t - c + O(h^(m+1))` near the expansion point, then order-`m` jet
identities for the three pieces assemble into the corresponding identity for `f`.
items.title: ofFunction_split_of_isBigO_succ

items.label: ofFunction_sub_congr
items.statement: Equality of two pairs of one-variable jets is preserved by pointwise subtraction.
items.title: ofFunction_sub_congr

items.label: ofFunction_sub_eq_zero_of_eq
items.statement: Equal jets have a difference whose finite jet is the zero jet.
items.title: ofFunction_sub_eq_zero_of_eq

items.label: partialSum_five_mixed_cubic_quartic_isBigO
items.statement:
For a formal power series, the mixed part of its degree-four partial sum along
`ε • u + ε³ • v₃ + ε⁴ • v₄` is order five when the quadratic cross coefficient
in the `(u, v₃)` directions vanishes.
items.title: partialSum_five_mixed_cubic_quartic_isBigO

items.label: postcomp_def
items.statement:
Analytic postcomposition is normalized formal-series composition with the
outer derivative jet.
items.title: postcomp_def

items.label: remainder_def
items.statement: The remainder is the function value at `x + h` minus the evaluated jet.
items.title: remainder_def

items.label: remainder_ofFunction_isLittleO
items.statement:
The derivative-constructed one-variable finite jet has Peano remainder
`o(h ^ m)` at its expansion point.
items.title: remainder_ofFunction_isLittleO

items.label: replaceTopCoeff_coeff_of_lt
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the replacement jet agrees with the source
jet at every degree strictly below the top order.
items.title: replaceTopCoeff_coeff_of_lt

items.label: replaceTopCoeff_coeff_top
items.statement:
