induction), then package the core tuple at order `r - 1`.  This is exactly the frozen certificate
field `topSection` at order `r`.
items.title: topSectionWitness_at_of_core

items.label: topSectionWitness_of_core
items.statement:
Package a core tuple at order `m = r - 1` into the holonomic `topSection` obligation for
order `r`, in the exact `∃ a, Continuous a ∧ ∀ u, HasFDerivAt … ((a u).curryLeft) u` shape.
items.title: topSectionWitness_of_core

items.label: topSection_of_scalar_core
items.statement:
Package a scalar top-section core into the holonomic top-section witness at order `m + 1`.
`a u := (topSectionValue m (v u)).curryLeft`-style witness with the continuity and the curried
Fréchet derivative equation for `y ↦ (ftaylorSeries ℝ ζ y) m`.
items.title: topSection_of_scalar_core

items.label: uniformContinuous_centerMap_deriv
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the center-map derivative is uniformly continuous on the
whole source line.
items.title: uniformContinuous_centerMap_deriv

items.label: uniformContinuous_metricOrderOneFixedSlope
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the canonical fixed slope is uniformly continuous on the
whole source line.
items.title: uniformContinuous_metricOrderOneFixedSlope

items.label: uniformContinuous_metricOrderOneRDerivative
items.statement:
Supporting fact: compact support and `C²` regularity make the derivative of
the smooth remainder uniformly continuous on the whole product space.
items.title: uniformContinuous_metricOrderOneRDerivative

items.label: uniformContinuous_metricReservedTopCoefficient
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the reserved-top coefficient itself is uniformly continuous
because its difference from the exterior constant coefficient has compact support.
items.title: uniformContinuous_metricReservedTopCoefficient

items.label: uniformContinuous_metricReservedTopCoefficient_deriv
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the derivative of the reserved-top coefficient is uniformly
continuous on the whole source line.
items.title: uniformContinuous_metricReservedTopCoefficient_deriv

items.label: uniformContinuous_metricReservedTopForcing_deriv
items.statement:
Supporting fact: at every nontrivial predecessor order, the derivative of
the lower-order reserved-top forcing is uniformly continuous on the whole source line.
items.title: uniformContinuous_metricReservedTopForcing_deriv

items.label: uniformFirstOrderRemainder_of_uniformContinuous_deriv
items.statement:
Supporting fact: a differentiable function with uniformly continuous
derivative has a first-order Taylor remainder uniformly controlled over all translation centers.
items.title: uniformFirstOrderRemainder_of_uniformContinuous_deriv

items.label: withTopNatCast_add_sub_one
items.statement:
Supporting fact: finite natural orders are unchanged by the
successor-then-predecessor operation in the `WithTop ℕ∞` regularity index.
items.title: withTopNatCast_add_sub_one

items.label: zero_mem_metricSlopeSection
items.statement:
Supporting fact: the zero bounded section satisfies every nonnegative
slope bound.
items.title: zero_mem_metricSlopeSection

items.label: cfcSqrt
items.statement:
The continuous-functional-calculus square root of a positive-definite real matrix is positive
definite.
items.title: cfcSqrt

items.label: congr_linearIsometryEquiv
items.statement:
Positive definiteness is preserved by an isometric change of Euclidean
coordinates. The resulting matrix represents the transported operator in the
target's canonical basis.
items.title: congr_linearIsometryEquiv

items.label: dotProduct_mulVec_sq_le
items.statement: Cauchy–Schwarz for the weighted inner product induced by a real positive-definite matrix.
items.title: dotProduct_mulVec_sq_le

items.label: exists_sqrtEquiv_of_loewner_lowerBound
items.statement:
In finite-dimensional Euclidean space, a strict matrix Loewner lower bound supplies the
self-adjoint invertible square-root factorization of the associated continuous operator.
items.title: exists_sqrtEquiv_of_loewner_lowerBound

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate
items.statement: The inverse-form DFP update preserves positive definiteness.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_denominator_pos
items.statement: Positive definiteness and positive curvature make the quadratic denominator positive.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_denominator_pos

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_ne_zero
items.statement: Both scalar denominators in the inverse-form DFP update are nonzero.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_ne_zero

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_pos
items.statement:
Positive definiteness and positive secant curvature make both scalar
denominators of the inverse-form DFP update positive.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_pos

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_pos_smul
items.statement:
Positive definiteness and positive original curvature give positive
denominators for every common nonzero scaling of the secant pair.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_pos_smul

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
items.statement:
The pointwise quadratic-form positivity needed to construct
`Matrix.PosDef.inverseDFPUpdate`.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_dotProduct_mulVec_pos

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_projectedQuadratic_nonneg
items.statement:
Removing the rank-one component in the `H *ᵥ y` direction leaves a
nonnegative quadratic form.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_projectedQuadratic_nonneg

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_smul_pair
items.statement:
Positive definiteness of an inverse-form DFP update is invariant under a
common nonzero scaling of its secant pair.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_smul_pair

items.label: sqrtEquiv_isSelfAdjoint
items.statement: The Euclidean square-root equivalence is self-adjoint.
items.title: sqrtEquiv_isSelfAdjoint

items.label: sqrtEquiv_pushforward_one
items.statement:
The original positive-definite matrix is the pushforward of the identity by its positive
square-root equivalence.
items.title: sqrtEquiv_pushforward_one

items.label: sqrtEquiv_sq
items.statement:
Squaring the Euclidean square-root equivalence gives the Euclidean realization of the
original matrix.
items.title: sqrtEquiv_sq

items.label: sqrtEquiv_symm_pushforward
items.statement: The inverse square-root coordinate change normalizes the original matrix to the identity.
items.title: sqrtEquiv_symm_pushforward

items.label: sqrtEquiv_toContinuousLinearMap
items.statement:
The endomorphism underlying `sqrtEquiv` is the Euclidean realization of the matrix square
root.
items.title: sqrtEquiv_toContinuousLinearMap

items.label: conjugate_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
items.statement:
Conjugating a matrix and transporting a vector by the same orthogonal
matrix commutes with matrix-vector multiplication.
items.title: conjugate_mulVec_of_mem_orthogonalGroup

items.label: conjugate_vecMulVec
items.statement:
Conjugation transports a self outer product to the self outer product of
the transported vector.
items.title: conjugate_vecMulVec

items.label: det_inverseDFPUpdate
items.statement:
The determinant of an inverse-form DFP update is the old determinant multiplied by
the ratio of secant curvature to the inverse-Hessian quadratic form.
items.title: det_inverseDFPUpdate

items.label: dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
items.statement:
An orthogonal matrix preserves the real coordinate dot product under
matrix-vector multiplication.
items.title: dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_mem_orthogonalGroup

items.label: dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
items.statement: A special orthogonal matrix preserves the real coordinate dot product.
items.title: dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_apply
items.statement: The entrywise formula for the inverse-form DFP update.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_apply

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_conjugate_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
items.statement:
For a Hermitian base matrix, the inverse-form DFP update commutes with an
orthogonal change of coordinates.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_conjugate_of_mem_orthogonalGroup

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_def
items.statement:
The inverse-form DFP update is the sum of its base matrix and the two
rank-one correction terms.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_def

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_ne_zero_smul_iff
items.statement:
A common nonzero scale preserves exactly the two nonvanishing denominator
conditions used by the inverse-form DFP update.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_denominators_ne_zero_smul_iff

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_dotProduct_mulVec
items.statement:
The quadratic form of an inverse-form DFP update, before using symmetry of the
base matrix.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_dotProduct_mulVec

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_dotProduct_mulVec_of_isHermitian
items.statement:
For a Hermitian real base matrix, the quadratic form of the inverse-form DFP
update is the usual difference and sum of two scalar squares.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_dotProduct_mulVec_of_isHermitian

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_isHermitian
items.statement: An inverse-form DFP update of a Hermitian real matrix is Hermitian.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_isHermitian

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_metric_denominator_smul
items.statement:
Simultaneously scaling both vectors in a secant pair scales the quadratic
denominator involving the base matrix by the square of the scalar.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_metric_denominator_smul

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_mulVec_apply
items.statement: The action of the inverse-form DFP update on a vector, expanded at one coordinate.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_mulVec_apply

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_mulVec_secant
items.statement:
If both update denominators are nonzero, the inverse-form DFP update sends
the secant vector `y` to the displacement vector `s`.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_mulVec_secant

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_mulVec_smul_secant
items.statement:
Under the original nonvanishing denominator hypotheses, the update formed
from a scaled secant pair sends `c • y` to `c • s`.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_mulVec_smul_secant

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_secant_denominator_pos_smul_iff
items.statement: A common nonzero scale preserves positivity of the secant curvature.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_secant_denominator_pos_smul_iff

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_secant_denominator_smul
items.statement:
Simultaneously scaling both vectors in a secant pair scales its curvature
denominator by the square of the scalar.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_secant_denominator_smul

items.label: inverseDFPUpdate_smul_pair
items.statement:
The inverse-form DFP update is unchanged when both vectors of the secant
pair are multiplied by the same nonzero scalar.
items.title: inverseDFPUpdate_smul_pair

items.label: isPositive_toEuclideanCLM_iff
items.statement: A real matrix is positive semidefinite exactly when its Euclidean operator is positive.
items.title: isPositive_toEuclideanCLM_iff

items.label: norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
items.statement:
An orthogonal matrix preserves the Euclidean norm under matrix-vector
multiplication.
items.title: norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_mem_orthogonalGroup

items.label: norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
items.statement: A special orthogonal matrix preserves the Euclidean norm.
items.title: norm_toLp_mulVec_eq_of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup

items.label: posDef_of_loewner_lowerBound
items.statement: A strict scalar Loewner lower bound makes a real finite matrix positive definite.
items.title: posDef_of_loewner_lowerBound

items.label: posDef_of_quadraticForm_lowerBound
items.statement:
A Hermitian real matrix with a strictly positive quadratic-form lower bound is positive
definite.
items.title: posDef_of_quadraticForm_lowerBound

items.label: toEuclideanCLM_inverseDFPUpdate
items.statement:
The Euclidean operator represented by a matrix DFP update is the coordinate-free operator
DFP update.
items.title: toEuclideanCLM_inverseDFPUpdate

items.label: affinity_unitSphere
items.statement:
The affine image of the unit sphere with center `C` and positive scale `R` is the
metric sphere of radius `R` about `C`.
items.title: affinity_unitSphere

items.label: disjoint_closedBall_of_pointwise_lower_bound
items.statement:
A pointwise distance lower bound separates every strictly smaller closed ball from the
punctured set carrying that bound.
items.title: disjoint_closedBall_of_pointwise_lower_bound

items.label: eventually_closedBall_subset_cthickening_of_tendsto
items.statement:
If both the center distance to a closed nonempty target and the radii tend
to zero, every positive closed thickening of the target eventually contains
the corresponding closed balls.
items.title: eventually_closedBall_subset_cthickening_of_tendsto

items.label: eventually_infDist_mem_Icc_of_support_radius_isLittleO
items.statement:
If center-to-target distance is asymptotic to a positive multiple of a
scale and the support radii are negligible relative to that distance, then
every point in the corresponding supports has target distance comparable to
the same scale.
items.title: eventually_infDist_mem_Icc_of_support_radius_isLittleO

items.label: half_dist_le_of_mem_isolationClosedBall
items.statement:
Points in subsets of distinct quarter-isolation closed balls are separated by at least
half the distance between the centers.
items.title: half_dist_le_of_mem_isolationClosedBall

items.label: infDist_affinity_unitSphere
items.statement:
The distance from a point to the affine image of a unit sphere with positive scale is
the absolute difference between its distance from the center and the scale.
items.title: infDist_affinity_unitSphere

items.label: infDist_pos_of_pointwise_lower_bound
items.statement:
A strictly positive pointwise separation certificate gives a strictly positive punctured
infimum distance from the distinguished point.
items.title: infDist_pos_of_pointwise_lower_bound

items.label: infDist_sphere
items.statement:
The distance from a point to a nonempty sphere in a real normed affine space is the
absolute radial deviation from that sphere.
items.title: infDist_sphere

items.label: injective_of_pos_le_dist
items.statement:
A positive pointwise lower bound on distances between distinct images makes
the indexed family injective.
items.title: injective_of_pos_le_dist

items.label: isolationClosedBall_disjoint_derivedSet
items.statement:
A quarter-isolation closed ball in a closed set is disjoint from the set's derived set
when the isolation distance is positive.
items.title: isolationClosedBall_disjoint_derivedSet

items.label: isolationDistance_eq
items.statement: The isolation distance is the infimum distance to the punctured set.
items.title: isolationDistance_eq

items.label: isolationDistance_nonneg
items.statement: Isolation distance is nonnegative.
items.title: isolationDistance_nonneg

items.label: isolationRadius_eq
items.statement: The isolation radius is one quarter of the punctured-set distance.
items.title: isolationRadius_eq

items.label: isolationRadius_lt_isolationDistance
items.statement:
When the isolation distance is positive, its quarter-radius is strictly
smaller.
items.title: isolationRadius_lt_isolationDistance

items.label: isolationRadius_nonneg
items.statement: Isolation radius is nonnegative.
items.title: isolationRadius_nonneg

items.label: le_infDist_diff_singleton_of_pointwise_lower_bound
items.statement:
A pointwise distance lower bound on a punctured set gives the same lower bound for its
infimum distance from the distinguished point.
items.title: le_infDist_diff_singleton_of_pointwise_lower_bound

items.label: le_infDist_union_range_diff_singleton
items.statement:
Pointwise lower bounds to a background set and an indexed family combine into a
lower bound for the distance to their union after removing the distinguished point.
items.title: le_infDist_union_range_diff_singleton

items.label: le_infDist_union_range_diff_singleton_of_not_mem
items.statement:
If the distinguished point is outside a nonempty background set, lower bounds to that
set and to every other indexed point bound the corresponding punctured infimum distance.
items.title: le_infDist_union_range_diff_singleton_of_not_mem

items.label: locallyFinite_closedBall_outside
items.statement:
Shrinking closed balls are locally finite at every point outside the set containing all
`atTop` cluster points of their centers.
items.title: locallyFinite_closedBall_outside

items.label: pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall_of_radius_add_lt_dist
items.statement:
Closed balls with radii whose pairwise sums are strictly below the corresponding center
distances form a pairwise-disjoint family.
items.title: pairwiseDisjoint_closedBall_of_radius_add_lt_dist

items.label: pairwiseDisjoint_isolationClosedBall
items.statement:
The quarter-isolation closed balls centered at distinct members of a set are pairwise
disjoint.
items.title: pairwiseDisjoint_isolationClosedBall

items.label: radiusGap_le_dist_add_errors
items.statement:
A lower bound for the gap between two approximate radii is bounded by the
distance between the points together with the two radius errors.
items.title: radiusGap_le_dist_add_errors

items.label: uniform_decay_of_le_scale_of_mul_scale_le_infDist
items.statement:
A quantity bounded by a fixed multiple of a scale converges uniformly to
zero along support points approaching a target, provided target distance is
bounded below by a positive multiple of the same scale.
items.title: uniform_decay_of_le_scale_of_mul_scale_le_infDist

items.label: abs_toReal_oangle_add_le
items.statement: Adding an error vector changes the real oriented angle by at most its relative size.
items.title: abs_toReal_oangle_add_le

items.label: abs_toReal_oangle_le
items.statement: A common positive lower norm bound controls the real oriented angle between two vectors.
items.title: abs_toReal_oangle_le

items.label: frame_diagonalizes
items.statement:
In the gradient-oriented frame, the symmetric matrix is diagonal with its low
eigenvalue first and high eigenvalue second.
items.title: frame_diagonalizes

items.label: frame_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
items.statement: On the explicit spectral chart, the gradient-oriented frame is special orthogonal.
items.title: frame_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup

items.label: inner_lowVector_pos
items.statement:
If the updated gradient is not orthogonal to the original low eigenvector, the
chosen low eigenvector has strictly positive inner product with it.
items.title: inner_lowVector_pos

items.label: lowVector_hasEigenvector
items.statement:
On the explicit spectral chart, changing the sign preserves the low-eigenvector
equation and nonvanishing condition.
items.title: lowVector_hasEigenvector

items.label: norm_lowVector
items.statement: On the explicit spectral chart, the gradient-oriented low eigenvector has unit norm.
items.title: norm_lowVector

items.label: abs_decrementError_le_of_residual
items.statement:
A controlled higher-order recurrence residual bounds the error in its leading
decrement term.
items.title: abs_decrementError_le_of_residual

items.label: abs_sub_inv_mul_le_of_interval
items.statement:
An interval around `x / a` with positive denominators controls the absolute
error by the wider endpoint displacement.
items.title: abs_sub_inv_mul_le_of_interval

items.label: decrementBounds_of_residual
items.statement:
A controlled residual for a parabolic recurrence traps its one-step decrement
between the corresponding perturbed leading terms.
items.title: decrementBounds_of_residual

items.label: recurrence_tail_pow_error_of_residual
items.statement:
A uniform two-term parabolic recurrence residual controls the critical power
tail's absolute error from its leading value `ε i j / a`.
items.title: recurrence_tail_pow_error_of_residual

items.label: recurrence_tail_pow_error_of_two_sided_decrement
items.statement:
Two-sided decrement bounds yield an explicit error bound for the power-tail
sum around its leading coefficient `1 / a`.
items.title: recurrence_tail_pow_error_of_two_sided_decrement

items.label: sum_range_shift_sub
items.statement: A finite sum of consecutive decrements of a shifted real sequence telescopes.
items.title: sum_range_shift_sub

items.label: summable_tail_pow_and_tsum_le_of_decrement
items.statement:
A positive family whose decrement dominates `c * ε i j ^ (p + 1)` has uniformly
summable shifted `q`-power tails whenever `p + 1 ≤ q`, with the telescoping bound
`∑' k, ε i (j + k) ^ q ≤ c⁻¹ * ε i j ^ (q - p)`.
items.title: summable_tail_pow_and_tsum_le_of_decrement

items.label: summable_tail_pow_and_tsum_le_of_residual
items.statement:
A family with a uniform parabolic recurrence residual has uniformly summable
shifted higher-power tails, with the bound obtained from its leading decrement.
items.title: summable_tail_pow_and_tsum_le_of_residual

items.label: tendsto_div_natCast_of_tendsto_forwardDiff
items.statement:
If the forward differences of a real sequence tend to `c`, then the sequence divided by
the natural-number index tends to `c`. This is the telescoping form of Cesàro convergence.
items.title: tendsto_div_natCast_of_tendsto_forwardDiff

items.label: tendsto_invPow_forwardDiff_of_isBigO
items.statement:
For a positive parabolic recurrence, the forward differences of the reciprocal `p`-th
powers tend to `a * p`.
items.title: tendsto_invPow_forwardDiff_of_isBigO

items.label: tendsto_invPow_forwardDiff_of_ratio_and_scaledDecrement
items.statement:
A normalized decrement limit and a successive-ratio limit determine the forward difference
of the reciprocal `p`-th powers.
items.title: tendsto_invPow_forwardDiff_of_ratio_and_scaledDecrement

items.label: tendsto_ratio_one_of_isBigO
items.statement:
A positive sequence tending to zero and satisfying a parabolic recurrence has successive
ratio tending to one.
items.title: tendsto_ratio_one_of_isBigO

items.label: tendsto_scaledDecrement_of_isBigO
items.statement:
The parabolic recurrence residual of order `p + 2` makes the decrement, normalized by
`ε j ^ (p + 1)`, tend to its leading coefficient `a`.
items.title: tendsto_scaledDecrement_of_isBigO

items.label: tsum_tail_pow_interval_of_residual
items.statement:
A uniform two-term parabolic recurrence residual gives the sharp interval for
the critical power tail when every member of the family tends to zero.
items.title: tsum_tail_pow_interval_of_residual

items.label: tsum_tail_pow_interval_of_two_sided_decrement
items.statement:
Two-sided order-`p + 1` decrement bounds give the sharp interval for the
corresponding power tail when every sequence tends to zero.
items.title: tsum_tail_pow_interval_of_two_sided_decrement

items.label: existsLimit
items.statement:
A positive sequence whose successive ratios have a summable nonnegative first-order
perturbation converges to a positive limit.
items.title: existsLimit

items.label: subLimitIsEquivalent
items.statement:
The first-order tail expansion as an asymptotic equivalence when its coefficient
`c` is nonzero.
items.title: subLimitIsEquivalent

items.label: subLimitIsLittleO
items.statement:
If the shifted tail of `u` is asymptotic to `v`, then the error from the positive
limit has first-order term `c * aLim * v`.
items.title: subLimitIsLittleO

items.label: coe_eq_liftSequence_succ_sub_iff
items.statement:
A real number in the principal interval represents a consecutive angle increment
exactly when it equals the corresponding increment of the canonical lift.
items.title: coe_eq_liftSequence_succ_sub_iff

items.label: coe_liftSequence
items.statement: Coercing a canonical real lift back to `Real.Angle` recovers the original sequence.
items.title: coe_liftSequence

items.label: continuous_abs_toReal
items.statement:
Although the principal representative `Angle.toReal` jumps at the branch cut,
its absolute value is a globally continuous function of the angle.
items.title: continuous_abs_toReal

items.label: liftSequence_even_sub_eq_toReal_of_coe_of_mem_Ioc
items.statement:
Along the even subsequence of a canonical angle lift, a quotient-valued relation
with an arbitrary real comparison sequence determines the corresponding real
representative.  The only branch hypothesis is that the representative predicted by
two angle increments and one comparison increment lies in the principal interval.
items.title: liftSequence_even_sub_eq_toReal_of_coe_of_mem_Ioc

items.label: liftSequence_sub_eq_toReal_sub_of_mem_Ioc
items.statement:
Two canonical angle lifts stay on the branch represented by their quotient-valued
difference when the initial branches agree and every recursively predicted difference
lies in the principal interval.
items.title: liftSequence_sub_eq_toReal_sub_of_mem_Ioc

items.label: liftSequence_succ
items.statement:
A successor value of the canonical lift adds the canonical representative of the
corresponding angle increment.
items.title: liftSequence_succ

items.label: liftSequence_succ_sub
items.statement:
Consecutive values of the canonical lift differ by the canonical representative of
the corresponding quotient-angle increment.
items.title: liftSequence_succ_sub

items.label: liftSequence_zero
items.statement: The canonical lift starts at the canonical real representative of the first angle.
items.title: liftSequence_zero

items.label: windingNumber_pos_of_antitone
items.statement:
An antitone real angle lift has positive winding number whenever the
remainder in a full-turn decomposition is smaller than the first traversed
gap.  This isolates the order argument from any particular orbit or scale
estimate.
items.title: windingNumber_pos_of_antitone

items.label: analyticAt_signedSqrtBranch
items.statement:
If `q` is analytic at `0`, satisfies `q 0 = 1`, and is eventually positive near
`0`, then `ε ↦ ε * √(q ε)` is analytic at `0`.
items.title: analyticAt_signedSqrtBranch

items.label: antilipschitzWith_inv_of_pos_le_deriv
items.statement:
A positive derivative lower bound `lower` gives the reciprocal antilipschitz
constant `lower⁻¹`.
items.title: antilipschitzWith_inv_of_pos_le_deriv

items.label: arctan_comp_sub_cubic_isBigO
items.statement:
Composing the cubic arctangent remainder with an order-`n` slope germ gives an
order-`4n` remainder.
items.title: arctan_comp_sub_cubic_isBigO

items.label: arctan_sub_cubic_isBigO
items.statement: The cubic Taylor polynomial of `Real.arctan` has a fourth-order remainder at zero.
items.title: arctan_sub_cubic_isBigO

items.label: bijective_of_pos_le_deriv
items.statement:
A differentiable real function with a uniform positive lower derivative bound is
bijective.
items.title: bijective_of_pos_le_deriv

items.label: contDiff_invFun_of_pos_le_deriv
items.statement:
At every positive finite smoothness order, `Function.invFun` inherits the forward
map's `ContDiff` regularity.
items.title: contDiff_invFun_of_pos_le_deriv

items.label: diffeomorphOfPosLEDeriv_apply
items.statement: Evaluating `diffeomorphOfPosLEDeriv` applies its forward function.
items.title: diffeomorphOfPosLEDeriv_apply

items.label: diffeomorphOfPosLEDeriv_symm_apply
items.statement: Evaluating the inverse of `diffeomorphOfPosLEDeriv` applies `Function.invFun`.
items.title: diffeomorphOfPosLEDeriv_symm_apply

items.label: existsSubseqAddIntMulTendsto
items.statement:
Given a strictly decreasing real sequence tending to negative infinity whose successive
drops tend to zero, every target is approached along a subsequence after adding integer
multiples of any fixed positive period.
items.title: existsSubseqAddIntMulTendsto

items.label: exists_uniform_iteratedDeriv_invFun_bound
items.statement:
A family of `C^ν` real functions with a common positive derivative lower
bound and common higher-order forward derivative bounds admits one family-independent
bound for every inverse derivative through order `ν`.
items.title: exists_uniform_iteratedDeriv_invFun_bound

items.label: hasDerivAt_signedSqrtBranch
items.statement:
If `q` is analytic at `0`, satisfies `q 0 = 1`, and is eventually positive near
`0`, then the derivative at `0` of `ε ↦ ε * √(q ε)` is `1`.

items.label: norm_iteratedDeriv_one_invFun_le
items.statement:
A uniform positive lower bound for the derivative of a `C¹` real function
gives the reciprocal uniform bound for the first derivative of its inverse.
items.title: norm_iteratedDeriv_one_invFun_le

items.label: norm_iteratedDeriv_three_invFun_le

If the second and third derivatives of a `C³` real function have common
bounds, then the third derivative of its inverse obeys the explicit scalar
inverse-function bound.
items.title: norm_iteratedDeriv_three_invFun_le

items.label: norm_iteratedDeriv_two_invFun_le

If the second derivative of a `C²` real function is bounded by

`secondBound * lower⁻¹ ^ 3`.
items.title: norm_iteratedDeriv_two_invFun_le

items.label: signedSqrtBranch_eventuallyEq_sqrt
items.statement:
On a sufficiently small right neighborhood of `0`, the signed square-root branch

items.label: strictMono_of_pos_le_deriv
items.statement:
A differentiable real function with a uniform positive lower derivative bound is
strictly increasing.

A differentiable real function with a uniform positive lower derivative bound is

items.title: surjective_of_pos_le_deriv

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_pos_le_deriv

A differentiable real function with a uniform positive lower derivative bound tends
to `atBot` at `atBot`.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_pos_le_deriv

items.label: tendsto_atTop_of_pos_le_deriv

A differentiable real function with a uniform positive lower derivative bound tends
to `atTop` at `atTop`.
items.title: tendsto_atTop_of_pos_le_deriv

items.label: tsum_nat_add_rpow_isEquivalent
items.statement:
The tail of the real `p`-series with exponent `s > 1` is asymptotic to

items.title: tsum_nat_add_rpow_isEquivalent

comparison tail give the corresponding big-O bound for the distance to the
limit.

A pointwise comparison for forward differences and a summable comparison
tail give a pointwise bound on the distance to the limit.

remaining displacement.

Helper for cor:identity-initialization: a linear pullback preserves a
global Hölder Hessian estimate.

items.label: normSq_mem_Icc_of_norm_mem_Icc
items.statement: Squaring a nonnegative norm interval preserves its endpoint ordering.
items.title: normSq_mem_Icc_of_norm_mem_Icc

items.label: norm_fderiv_gradient_eq_norm_fderiv_fderiv
items.statement:
Passing from the derivative covector to its Riesz-representing gradient preserves the
operator norm of the second Fréchet derivative.
items.title: norm_fderiv_gradient_eq_norm_fderiv_fderiv

items.label: norm_fderiv_gradient_eq_norm_iteratedFDeriv_two
items.statement:
The Hessian operator norm also agrees with the norm of the order-two iterated
Fréchet derivative.
items.title: norm_fderiv_gradient_eq_norm_iteratedFDeriv_two

items.label: norm_firstOrderRemainder_le_of_holderDerivative
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: a Hölder derivative on a segment
gives a remainder of order `1 + β`. This upstream-worthy mean-value estimate
does not require the sharp integral constant.
items.title: norm_firstOrderRemainder_le_of_holderDerivative

items.label: norm_hessian_eq_norm_iteratedFDeriv_two
items.statement: The Hessian norm agrees with the norm of the second iterated Frechet derivative.
items.title: norm_hessian_eq_norm_iteratedFDeriv_two

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_affine_le
items.statement:
Precomposition by the affine map `x ↦ A x + b` multiplies the pointwise norm of
the `n`-th iterated Fréchet derivative by at most `‖A‖ ^ n`.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_affine_le

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_at_center_le
items.statement:
A uniform bound for the iterated derivatives of centered summands gives the same bound
for the corresponding derivative of the pointwise finsum at every active center.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_at_center_le

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_le_of_tsupport_bound
items.statement:
A uniform bound for one iterated derivative on each summand's topological support
gives the same bound for the pointwise finsum away from the cluster set.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_le_of_tsupport_bound

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_le_of_weighted_tsupport_bound
items.statement:
A nonnegative weight bounded by `W` turns a supportwise estimate
`‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (ψ k) z‖ ≤ C * w k` into the uniform `C * W` bound
needed by the disjoint-finsum derivative theorem.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_le_of_weighted_tsupport_bound

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_le_of_tsupport
items.statement:
A nonnegative bound for an iterated derivative on the topological support of the
original function is automatically a global bound.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_le_of_tsupport

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_one_comp_affine_le
items.statement:
Precomposition by the affine map `x ↦ A x + b` multiplies the pointwise norm of
the first iterated Fréchet derivative by at most `‖A‖`.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_one_comp_affine_le

items.label: norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_comp_affine_le
items.statement:
Precomposition by the affine map `x ↦ A x + b` multiplies the pointwise norm of
the second iterated Fréchet derivative by at most `‖A‖ ^ 2`.
items.title: norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_comp_affine_le

items.label: norm_secondFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedFDeriv_two
items.statement:
The norm of the ordinary second Fréchet derivative agrees with the norm of the
order-two iterated Fréchet derivative.
items.title: norm_secondFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedFDeriv_two

items.label: norm_secondFDeriv_indicator_compl_finsum_le_of_tsupport_bound
items.statement:
A supportwise Hessian bound for disjoint shrinking summands gives the same global
bound after their pointwise finsum is extended by zero across the closed cluster set.
items.title: norm_secondFDeriv_indicator_compl_finsum_le_of_tsupport_bound

items.label: norm_secondFDeriv_indicator_compl_finsum_le_of_weighted_tsupport_bound
items.statement:
A weighted supportwise second-derivative estimate gives the uniform Hessian bound
for the zero extension of a disjoint finsum, provided the value and first-derivative
decay hypotheses needed at the cluster set are available.
items.title: norm_secondFDeriv_indicator_compl_finsum_le_of_weighted_tsupport_bound

items.label: quadraticQuantity_mem_Icc_of_norm_mem_Icc
items.statement:
A norm interval and a quadratic comparison in that norm give a quadratic
interval at the underlying scale.
items.title: quadraticQuantity_mem_Icc_of_norm_mem_Icc

items.label: slowCurveBumpCorrectionHessianBound
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Global Hessian bound for the bump correction): one positive
constant chosen before the final initial scale bounds the Hessian of the global
bump correction at every point by that constant times the initial scale.
items.title: slowCurveBumpCorrectionHessianBound

items.label: slowCurveBumpCorrection_eqOn_zero
items.statement: The source-presented global bump correction vanishes on its limiting circle.
items.title: slowCurveBumpCorrection_eqOn_zero

items.label: slowCurveBumpCorrection_gradient_eqOn_zero
items.statement:
The source-presented gradient of the global bump correction vanishes on
its limiting circle.
items.title: slowCurveBumpCorrection_gradient_eqOn_zero

items.label: slowCurveBumpCorrection_hessian_eqOn_zero
items.statement:
The source-presented Hessian of the global bump correction vanishes on its
limiting circle.
items.title: slowCurveBumpCorrection_hessian_eqOn_zero

items.label: slowCurveBumpFDerivUniformBound
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Uniform supportwise value, gradient, and Hessian bounds) (2):
uniformly over sufficiently small initial scales, the norm of the first Fréchet
derivative (the source gradient) of each endpoint bump on its support is bounded by a
constant times the cycle scale and the endpoint radius.
items.title: slowCurveBumpFDerivUniformBound

items.label: slowCurveBumpSecondFDerivUniformBound
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Uniform supportwise value, gradient, and Hessian bounds) (3):
uniformly over sufficiently small initial scales, the norm of the second Fréchet
derivative (the source Hessian) of each endpoint bump on its support is bounded by a
constant times the cycle scale.
items.title: slowCurveBumpSecondFDerivUniformBound

items.label: slowCurveBumpValueUniformBound
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Uniform supportwise value, gradient, and Hessian bounds) (1):
uniformly over sufficiently small initial scales, the value of each endpoint bump on
its support is bounded by a constant times the cycle scale and the square of the
endpoint radius.
items.title: slowCurveBumpValueUniformBound

items.label: slowCurveInterpolationClosedBallDisjointLimitCircle
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Isolation radii and pairwise-disjoint interpolation balls) (3):
uniformly over sufficiently small initial scales, every closed interpolation ball is
disjoint from the limiting circle.
items.title: slowCurveInterpolationClosedBallDisjointLimitCircle

items.label: slowCurveInterpolationRadiusUniformBounds
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Isolation radii and pairwise-disjoint interpolation balls) (1):
uniformly over sufficiently small initial scales, every interpolation radius is bounded
above and below by positive multiples of the squared scale of its cycle.
items.title: slowCurveInterpolationRadiusUniformBounds

items.label: slowCurvePairwiseDisjointInterpolationClosedBalls
items.statement:
Supporting Lemma (Isolation radii and pairwise-disjoint interpolation balls) (2):
uniformly over sufficiently small initial scales, the closed interpolation balls are
pairwise disjoint.
items.title: slowCurvePairwiseDisjointInterpolationClosedBalls

items.label: slowCurveRealizedObjectiveHessianBounds
items.statement:
Supporting Proposition (Global Hessian bounds) (2): whenever
`K * ε₀ ≤ 1 / 2`, the Hessian of the realized objective lies globally between
`(1 / 2)I` and `(3 / 2)I`.
items.title: slowCurveRealizedObjectiveHessianBounds

items.label: squaredNorm_div_mem_Icc_of_norm_mem_Icc
items.statement:
Separate positive norm and decrease intervals give a uniform interval for
their squared-norm-to-decrease ratio.
items.title: squaredNorm_div_mem_Icc_of_norm_mem_Icc

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_abs_forwardDiff_add_le_of_not_summable
items.statement:
An eventual absolute error bound around a negative leading forward difference forces
divergence to `atBot` when the retained positive part is nonsummable.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_abs_forwardDiff_add_le_of_not_summable

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_abs_forwardDiff_add_le_of_square_vanishing
items.statement:
A fourth-order absolute remainder around the decrement `3 * ε n ^ 2` forces a real
sequence to tend to `atBot` when `ε n` tends to zero and its square is nonsummable.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_abs_forwardDiff_add_le_of_square_vanishing

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_abs_forwardDiff_add_le_of_vanishing_factor
items.statement:
If the error in a forward-difference estimate is bounded by `C * v n * w n`, where
`w` tends to zero, then a nonsummable nonnegative `v` still forces
the sequence to tend to `atBot`.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_abs_forwardDiff_add_le_of_vanishing_factor

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_le_decrement_of_not_summable
items.statement:
If the eventual decrement of a real sequence dominates a positive multiple of a
nonnegative nonsummable sequence, then the original sequence tends to `atBot`.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_le_decrement_of_not_summable

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_succ_add_le_of_not_summable
items.statement:
A real sequence that eventually decreases by nonnegative increments with a
nonsummable series tends to `atBot`.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_eventually_succ_add_le_of_not_summable

items.label: tendsto_atBot_of_succ_add_le_of_not_summable
items.statement:
A real sequence that decreases by nonnegative increments whose series is not summable
tends to `atBot`.
items.title: tendsto_atBot_of_succ_add_le_of_not_summable

items.label: tendsto_norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_div_infDist_pow
items.statement:
A supportwise scaled decay estimate for disjoint shrinking summands gives the
same decay for their pointwise finsum along the complement of the cluster set.
items.title: tendsto_norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_div_infDist_pow

items.label: tendsto_of_tendsto_even_odd
items.statement:
If the even and odd subsequences of a sequence converge to the same point,
the whole sequence converges to that point.
items.title: tendsto_of_tendsto_even_odd

project.title: A Counterexample to Global Convergence of Classical DFP Under the Standard Strong Wolfe Conditions
